9rVk: Prontera, the capital of Rune-Midgard, is filled with beautiful buildings that were thoroughly designed.
97Vk: Here, they have a leader called 'king,' who used to arrange marriages.
+LVk: There are many arenas, in which warriors race and wrestle to compete with each other.
+bVk: The group of winners are supposedly to get some kind of rewards, but seems like it lost its popularity nowadays.
+rVk: You need to be careful because there are some people in Prontera with superhuman powers.
+7Vk: They're able to destroy any type of weapons or armors with a few punches, and what they use for that is just a small hammer.
/LVk: I don't understand why adventurers keep laying tools at their feet. Could it be that they're priests and people are offering a tribute to them?
/bVk: There's a village called Payon in the forest. It has a place called 'Palace' as well, although its purpose is unclear.
/rVk: Maybe it's a place used before Prontera became the capital of Rune-Midgard...
/7Vk: Humans, too, establish border towns close to the boundary of their residential area, and the city of Aldebaran is one of them.
ALZk: In the middle of the village, there are clock-shaped monsters living in a clock tower. Further investigation is needed to find out why monsters appear in the middle of the village.
AbZk: Although it's called a clock tower, there are more monsters inside than clocks. I personally count them my self, I really did!
ArZk: Geffen, a city built by great wizards, is characterized by Tower of Wizards in the middle of the city.
A7Zk: Come to think of it, there's a fountain in the center of Prontera, a clock tower in Aldebaran, and a tower in Geffen as well.
BLZk: Maybe human's urban planning is based on symmetry or circular placement. I think it's less sophisticated.
BbZk: Izlude is a port city and is the gateway to Prontera. Since humans can't fly, they travel in big boxes.
BrZk: I'm sure they think that big boxes made a great contribution to their civilization...but is it true?
B7Zk: Alberta is a place that people of Rune-Midgard visit when they need to travel to other countries.
CLZk: There are many ships--a moving box that floats on water--ready and people travel on them.
CbZk: Seriously, human capability is...so disappointing. If they're wise enough, they'll use Warp-portal.
CrZk: Morroc Village is known to be a place where Morroc, the king of demons, rests.
C7Zk: Making waterways and lakes in the barren inhospitable desert...what an exceptional piece of work for humans.
DLZk: I think it's a very peaceful place...at least until monsters appear in the buildings where their leader is burried.
DbZk: There is the sea in the east of Rune-Midgard, a desert in the south, forest and vegetation in the middle, and mountains in the north.
DrZk: If you ask children to draw a world, wouldn't they draw it like this?
D7Zk: However, it's not an ideal place nor is it a great place to live.
ELZk: Humans often find great joy in venturing their lives in uncertain future.
EbZk: Comodo is a place for people who gamble with their future for something called 'fortune.' It seems irrelevant to ruling the kingdom though.
ErZk: Unidentifiable groups such as 'Female and Foot Volleyball' and 'Play Ranking Committee' got rid of games in that city.
E7Zk: Comodo was known to be a beach city filled with pleasure, and it used to be a place where you could find all sorts of entertainment. But I can't really say if it's still like that.
FLZk: There's a female priest, who is admired by the people of the village, and there seems to be good reasons for her existence.
FbZk: People bring her diamonds as a tribute, and she gives them gods' gifts in return. Although it seems like you have to be pretty lucky to receive it...
FrZk: First of all, I would like to start this book by expressing my respect to the challenging spirit of humans.
F7Zk: In Umbala, where a gigantic tree forms a village, there are people who challenge themselves to jump off from tall trees for various reasons.
GLZk: It's kind of strange if you think about it. I thought jumping off from a tree was a type of coming-of-age ceremony for human males. I can't believe there's another reason for it.
GbZk: Comodo is the only village in the southern part of this continent.
GrZk: Then, what is Paros Lighthouse for?
G7Zk: Further investigation is delayed because only a sailor is stationed in that area currently and I couldn't find any evidence to suggest that a political or social organization is involved in that area.
HLZk: You can get to an island called Bahia by boat, and you can find an underground cave there.
HbZk: The existence of such a deep and long cave in an island is a geographical mystery!
HrZk: Moreover, would any scholar be able to explain how humans here can breathe without gills in a place filled with water?
H7Zk: Prontera is a big city, so ensuring the stable supply of resources is very important.
ILZk: Especially, the supply of water resources is important for humans are vulnerable and they can't survive even for 30 days without water.
IbZk: Therefore, they built a huge building that looks like a water and sewer facility...
IrZk: But why can't I find the entrance inside the city? Is it a structural problem? Or is it for security?
I7Zk: Glastheim, the ruins of what was once a great castle.
JLZk: Soon, they're going to reveal what have happened here and the story behind it. So, let's focus on the development of the situation.
JbZk: Anyway, there are a number of monsters living together in more than 10 regions; all in the upper and lower parts of Glastheim.
JrZk: More detailed geographic information on this region is...so limited that I want to just grab any urban engineer by the collar and start asking.
J7Zk: Although human civilization is advanced enough to establish a country, humans are not accumulating knowledge but merely shifting their focus from one to another,
KLZk: and it seems like they're no longer able to differentiate a certain tree or grass from another.
KbZk: Otherwise, they wouldn't have named this well-organized forest as 'the mysterious forest.' I can't believe they gave such a strange name to this forest just because they can't find their way out.
KrZk: They might have believed that language is an exclusive possession of human. But I'm sure they changed their mind after meeting us, the fairies.
K7Zk: However, they're not surprised to see that some cats, much bigger in size than normal ones, are living in a socialized society and are able to communicate with humans.
LLZk: There's something I don't know. Should I reveal the truth?
LbZk: Breaking News: Thoughts on a secret place.
LrZk: There is constant exploitation and harrassment going on in a monastery, not far from Prontera.
L7Zk: They lure people who attempt to walk in god's way and make them gather mushrooms or run long distances...why is this acceptable!
MLZk: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about the northern parts of Midgard. -
MbZk: Humans continued to float big boxes on water and the sea, and finally, they began to use the sky.
MrZk: Where are they going next? Underground? Or are they going to transcend time and space?
M7Zk: At this rate, people will be willing to travel to the past. Human's technological advancements require attention.
NLZk: Einbroch is filled with machines. They don't seem to manufacture a lot of industrial goods, but machines are their weapons definitely.
NbZk: What are those numerous factories producing, and for what are people working?
NrZk: Don't they know that civilization development doesn't necessarily improve the value of life?
N7Zk: If you take a train in Einbroch, you can get to a village called Einbech.
OLZk: Of couse I hate this form of transportation (smells like iron too much), but it's a useful for humans because of its cheap price and transport capacity.
ObZk: By the way, don't they have enough materials to make railroad tracks? When will they make extensions to the train routes?
OrZk: Hugel, a small rural village, is like Comodo of southern region.
O7Zk: There are a variety of mini games and the landscape is very idyllic as well.
PLZk: But aren't those entertainment facilities supposed to be in the center of a country?
PbZk: A city called Yuno is even floating in the sky! How incredible is this.
PrZk: And there is a special reward for those who escape the maze: there is a place where rebirth is given.
P7Zk: Humans are truly scary. But I feel like I've seen this maze somewhere...
QLZk: In Rachel, the capital of Arunafeltz, there lives a small, cute, and white creature that seems really soft.
QbZk: If you thought of siroma, you are wrong. It's not marine either.
QrZk: The answer is a girl who is both a priest and a leader. This is because Arunafeltz is a theocratic entity.
Q7Zk: In the plains of Audhumbla, there lives many monster flowers and herbivore animals.
RLZk: Although one would think that they are not herbivores seeing how they attack humans, but
RbZk: if they were really carnivores, what food would they live on? Moreover, there is no record of them eating the adventurers who travel by after attacking them.
RrZk: Veins, a village built on a hill, seems like a well-planned city.
R7Zk: While it's confusing to know where you would exit and enter from, but
SLZk: if you want to see interesting sights such as a stone eating up a coin you dropped, it's a good place to visit.
SbZk: There was also a place that was extremely hot somewhere in Arunafeltz..
SrZk: The heat there felt like it would burn through my wings in their entirety. The residents of that place also did not seem very friendly.
S7Zk: So I had to stop the expedition. I hope that you, the readers, would also distance yourselves from that place.
TLZk: Well...It's not that I was afraid of the guardian there, you see!
TbZk: In Lighthalzen, there is a colossal building constructed by technicians. Although what they exactly do in there is a little suspicious...
TrZk: I'm not sure if a profit-seeking corporation should be doing something like that.
T7Zk: It's also very strange that clean and dirty areas in the city are divided...
ULZk: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about various regions in Midgard. -
UbZk: If you ride the boats in Alberta, you can get to various destinations.
UrZk: I don't know why so many of these boats end up at Alberta specifically, but for that, traveling is much easier.
U7Zk: Places you can reach through Alberta are as follows.
VLZk: A country of Gods, Amatsu, a place of refuge, Kunlun, Louyang where many martial art experts reside, Ayothaya in which a huge sculpture is present, and many others.
VbZk: I can see that more places would be available in the future as delegates from many other countries are arriving there more recently.
VrZk: Among those places that can be reached by boats, there is one famous destination.
V7Zk: Regrettably for them, they didn't take me just because I am a lone traveler. It wasn't even that they would give me a discount on the boat ride.
WLZk: As a scholar, I couldn't be more enraged by the ignorance of the Jawaii-bound ship's captain. Even during wars, historians are exempt from hostility.
WbZk: Also from Alberta, there is an island known for its high concentration of turtles.
WrZk: There are no regular routes, but after a long research, I found out that there is a captain who travels specifically to that place.
W7Zk: Upon getting there, there were many exotic turtles including cold turtles, hot turtles, and ninja turtles.
XLZk: From Clock Tower Village, I could arrive at a snowing village through an elderly man who wears thick, red clothes all year around.
XbZk: The entire village was covered by snow, and as expected from a place that is preparing for a celebration, the atmosphere was great.
XrZk: Inside the village, there was also a place that produces toys for children, but for some reason, they chased me out.
X7Zk: Among those places that can be reached by boats, there is a small island where a wrecked ship rests.
YLZk: I'm not sure if the ship was to be salvaged, but it was already occupied by strange creatures.
YbZk: The main god of the faith practiced in this continent is Odin. Accordingly, there is a temple for Odin as well.
YrZk: I was also outcasted here. People had no conception of hospitality and generosity toward outsiders.
Y7Zk: Near the south of the village were some docks. I researched a long time to see how these docks were being used, but I just couldn't find the answer.
ZLZk: But soon, I discovered the destination from those docks by following adventurers who secretly utilized them.
ZbZk: As scary as it was, what I saw there was truly shocking.
ZrZk: It is only right for an adventurer to record all that was seen, but because it is a politically sensitive material to be revealed, I will leave it at that.

Reader's memoir
Exploring MalangdoX Records on refinementO
jbZk: Malangdo, an island of cats. So soft and tender, ah...it's an island filled with lovely cats. Aww, what should I do...they're all so cute and lovely that I wanted to hug...
jrZk: them...yes, I wanted to, until I met these scary father cat and his daughter.
j7Zk: Yes, I was waiting to catch the King Octopus. I guess it was when I was passing by a boat? I met a cat with slanted eyes.
kLZk: That cat introduced himself and told me that he studied in Morroc.
kbZk: Then he assured me that he could upgrade my +9 Violet Fear to +10 Violet Fear.
krZk: He sounded so reliable since he studied abroad and all that, right? So I trusted him and gave him my +9 Violet Fear.
k7Zk: Then my +9 Violet Fear shattered into pieces. I was so shocked because it was the only weapon that I had.
lLZk: I spent all of my money to buy a Enriched Oridecon, too. Right, I couldn't trust him 100% even if he studied abroad.
lbZk: So I comforted myself and mourned for my +9 Violet Fear.
lrZk: But that wasn't the end. After that, a little cat approached me, saying she has a hammer that can refine even the stars in the sky.
l7Zk: A hammer that refines the starts in the sky! Doesn't it sound awesome? Since I lost my only weapon, I thought I should strengthen my armors. So I gave her everything I had.
mLZk: Shoes, clothes, armor, and even helmet...everything I had is just gone...now that I think about it, she said it's a hammer that can refine the stars of the sky.
mbZk: But she didn't say it doesn't break things, right? So, if you ever visit Malando, be aware of those cats called 'Strip' and 'Shatter.' I'm a Rune Knight and I still catch Porings...you don't want to be like me...

[Old Man]

my business has become better and better. But...
Well, I am having a hard time keeping a good stock of food ingredients.
YRJ6:

I cannot make my ultra nice menus with common ingredients because they are super special!
YhJ6:
[Bartender]
So I have been contacting super heavy champion hunters for fresh and special ingredients.

[Bartender]
I can't keep my business busy without my special menu 'Crunch Crunch Sour' and 'Savory Yum Yum'...*Sigh*

[Bartender]

aBJ6:
[Bartender]

Savory Yum Yum's basic ingredients are the grasshoppers romping in a place over the west forest. Yeah, it is the best selling menu ever.

I know lots of things about Prontera. I have seen many fine views and I also have explored some monster lairs around this city.
bRJ6: How could you enter monster lairs?
bhJ6:
[Shevild]
I may appear to be a drunken man but I am more than meets the eye.
Well, I happened to enter the places for carrying weapons for hunters or for delivering stuffs and whatsoever.
You might think of me as a mere delivery guy,
bxJ6:
[Shevild]
But I am very proud of my job. You know how tough the world has become?
No matter how hard a work is, I am not afraid of doing that.
cBJ6:
[Shevild]
Anyways, that is how I have explored some strange places like monster lairs...
That is also a reason why I keep my job.
Ah, I just recall being inside the maze and the spooky forest!
cxJ6:
[Shevild]
Yes. Few days ago, I have entered a mysterious maze following a group of hunters at the north of Prontera.
dBJ6:
[Shevild]
They said that they could get lots and lots of rare items from the maze even if the maze was filled with awfully strong mosters.
So we went there but as soon as we entered, we were just stuck inside the maze, you know.
dRJ6:
[Shevild]
We were just circling around and then we decided to leave the place. That was one hell of the maze.
But I made up my mind that I would successfully explore the maze one day.
dxJ6:
[Shevild]
Err? Haven't you still toured the outside of Prontera?
The maze can be found inside a forest at the north of Prontera. Go check the north west side of the forest.
eBJ6:
[Shevild]
Yeap, be careful when you adventure alone~
eRJ6:
[Shevild]
When you go outside of Prontrea heading to north east, you will arrive at the peaceful ruins. I have been there a while ago, to deliver something to a priest.
I had to pass a forest on the way to the ruins, and the forest was filled with Smokies and Yoyos.
ehJ6:
[Shevild]
Be forewarned that the forest is not a place to go on a picnic. If you drop something on the ground, the Yoyos come out from nowhere and take away all of your possessions.
exJ6:
[Shevild]
There is no road directly leads to the ruins. But if you go north and keep heading to east, you will get there.
Oh, be careful on your way to the ruins because there are some weird plant things that assault passersby for no reason.
fhJ6:
[TenSue]
What...?
Sick and tired of killing monsters on fields and in dungeons already? Come on...
fxJ6:
[TenSue]
Hahaha, it seems you're pretty confident of your strength, huh? Hmm... Why don't you go join a guild? I mean, all the tough guys are doing it.
gBJ6:
[TenSue]
Personally though, I don't know any guilds, so you'll have to ask around. Make some contacts, connections, you know, networking.
gRJ6:
[TenSue]
I don't even know if you don't like taking orders, but if that's the case, why don't you make your own guild?
ghJ6:
[TenSue]
One time I walked all the way to Al de Baran, instead of taking a warp. It was pretty dangerous with all those monsters!
gxJ6:
[TenSue]
I almost died! Some of those monsters just kept following me and trying to kill me, even though I did nothing to them! It was pretty crazy.
hBJ6:
[TenSue]
Well, still, I feel that taking the scenic route was worth it. There were some pretty magnificent sights on the way.
hRJ6:
[TenSue]
Even the city of Al de Baran is a splendid vision to the eyes, with its elegant architecture and romantic canal.
hhJ6:
[TenSue]
The headquarters of Kafra Corporation is also located in Al de Baran. You should really stop by and check it out for yourself.
hxJ6:
[TenSue]
The kingdom of
Rune-Midgard is ruled
by kind and benevolent
King Tristram III.
iBJ6:
[TenSue]
We really owe the prosperity of Rune-Midgard to him. He was able to convince the people to welcome outsiders into Prontera, as well as establish trade to foreign lands, like Amatsu and Kunlun.
iRJ6:
[TenSue]
But sometimes...
It can be hard to believe he's such a brilliant and capable leader.
ihJ6:
[TenSue]
After all, the only time I see him is when he's conducting weddings. Even if a wedding isn't going on, he's still kind of loitering around the Prontera church!
ixJ6:
[TenSue]
But...
I guess you can get away with a lot of things when you happen to be lord and ruler of an entire nation.
jRJ6:
[Marvin]
Whether it's schmoozing with a member of the opposite sex, or battling monsters, I gotta say, it's all about ^333399skills^000000.
jxJ6: I can't help you much when it comes to the subject of talking to attractive women such as myself, but I can tell you a little more about skills that help in battle.
kBJ6: I don't really have any advice for skills when it comes to talking to a cute guy, but I can let you in on what I know about skills that help in battle.
kRJ6:
[Marvin]
For most skills, the maximum level is level 10. It's easy to stress yourself out, since it takes so many points to completely master a skill. What skills should you choose?!
khJ6:
[Marvin]
After all, if you spend too many skill points on one skill, you might not be able to learn another. That's right, there's a limit to the number of total skill points you can earn.
kxJ6:
[Marvin]
But you know what? Not every skill is mastered at level 10. You can master some skills at only level 5. And even better, some skills are already mastered at level 1 or 2.
lBJ6:
[Marvin]
So relax and plan ahead, so you can master all the skills that you really want to master the most. Also, don't just put skill points into anything. Remember to use your skill points wisely.
lhJ6:
[Garnet]
Hello there~
Are you interested in learning more about helping and supporting other people?
lxJ6:
[Garnet]
The Acolytes and Priests trained in this church can heal people, cure them of certain conditions, and even awaken the battle potential of other adventurers.
mBJ6:
[Garnet]
Go and ahead and ask if you have any questions about skills for Acolytes and Priests.
oBJ6:
[Garnet]
You can recover your own HP with the ^6666CCHeal^000000 skill. Healing is one of the most important ways you can help your friends in battle.
oRJ6:
[Garnet]
Even though our powers are usually used to heal others, you can actually use the ^6666CCHeal^000000 skill to hurt Undead monsters.
ohJ6:
[Garnet]
Just remember to hold down the ^6666CCShift^000000 key when you use Cure or Heal on Undead monsters. Just be sure to hurt the monsters though, and don't use it to help monsters.
oxJ6:
[Garnet]
Later, if you've learned ^6666CCHeal^000000 as an Acolyte, you can learn ^6666CCSanctuary^000000 if you become a Priest.
pBJ6:
[Garnet]
Priests use ^6666CCSantuary^000000 to create an area which will restore the HP of you and your friends if you rest within the Sanctuary's area.
pRJ6:
[Garnet]
Once you reach ^6666CCLevel 2 Heal^000000 as an Acolyte, you can learn ^6666CCCure^000000, which can be used to treat abnormal statuses.
phJ6:
[Garnet]
This skill can be such a life saver, since almost every abnormal status can be cured with the Cure skill. Just remember that you need ^6666CCLevel 2 Heal^000000 before you can learn Cure.
pxJ6:
[Garnet]
Now, the ^6666CCIncrease AGI^000000 skill can be used on you or your friends. For a while your AGI stat is increased, making you attack faster and dodge monster attacks more easily.
qBJ6:
[Garnet]
If you're an Acolyte that wants to learn ^6666CCIncrease AGI^000000, you need to learn ^6666CCLevel 3 Heal^000000 first.
qRJ6:
[Garnet]
You can use ^6666CCAngelus^000000 to increase your Defense, as well as the Defense of other party members. Remember though, you can only use ^6666CCAngelus^000000 on other people if they are in your party.
qhJ6:
[Garnet]
Before you can learn Angelus, you will need to have ^6666CCLevel 3 Divine Protection^000000.
qxJ6:
[Garnet]
Also, if you keep learning Angelus, you'll eventually be able to learn ^6666CCKyrie Eleison^000000. That skill helps you evade initial attacks automatically.
rBJ6:
[Garnet]
^6666CCBlessing^000000 temporarily increases STR, DEX and INT. This skill will give you and your friends a great advantage in battle!
rRJ6:
[Garnet]
Before you can learn Blessing, you must first learn ^6666CCLevel 5 Divine Protection^000000.
rhJ6:
[Garnet]
^6666CCWarp Portal^000000 is a pretty complex skill, and you need to know some other skills before you can learn it.
rxJ6:
[Garnet]
First, you need to learn ^6666CCRuwach^000000 which lets you see invisible monsters. After Ruwach, you will need to learn the ^6666CCTeleport^000000 skill.
sBJ6:
[Garnet]
Once you learn ^6666CCWarp Portal^000000, the level of the Warp Portal skill will determine how many warp destinations, or Warp Points, you can memorize.
sRJ6:
[Garnet]
If you master the Warp Portal skill, you can have a maximum of 4 different Warp Points. But at least one Warp Point is designated as the Save Point that you've made with a Kafra Employee.
shJ6:
[Garnet]
Well, it's a bit of hassle, but if you want to make a certain place one of your Warp Points, you need to be physically there first. Then, type in ^6666CC/memo^000000 into the command prompt.
sxJ6:
[Garnet]
Just so you know, you can't save a Warp Point inside of a dungeon. Oh, and don't forget, each time you make a Warp Portal, you must use 1 ^6666CCBlue Gemstone^000000 as a Catalyst.
thJ6:
[Henson]
We Priests and Acolytes are not only limited to easing the suffering of our fellow man...
txJ6:
[Henson]
We also mete swift and merciless punishment to the forces of evil. Well, purifying any poor souls that may have been turned into the Undead is also another duty.
uBJ6:
[Henson]
Did you have any questions about Acolyte and Priest skills?
wRJ6:
[Henson]
If you want to permanently improve your Defense against the Undead, learn ^6666CCDivine Protection^000000.
whJ6:
[Henson]
Learning Divine Protection to certain levels will also allow you to learn other skills, like ^6666CCAngelus^000000 and ^6666CCBlessing^000000, which Garnet can explain.
wxJ6:
[Henson]
When you learn ^6666CCLevel 3 Divine Protection^000000, you will then be able to learn the ^6666CCDemon Bane^000000 skill.
xBJ6:
[Henson]
With ^6666CCDemon Bane^000000, the damage of your attacks against the Undead will be increased. Permanently.
xRJ6:
[Henson]
^6666CCDemon Bane^000000 increases the damage you will inflict upon the Undead. Permanently.
xhJ6:
[Henson]
First, you'll need to learn ^6666CCLevel 3 Divine Protection^000000 to be able to learn Demon Bane, so keep that in mind.
xxJ6:
[Henson]
When you learn ^6666CCLevel 3 Demon Bane^000000, you will be able to learn ^6666CCSignum Crusis^000000, which lowers the Defense of Undead monsters, as well as monsters with the Dark property.
yBJ6:
[Henson]
Using ^6666CCDecrease AGI^000000 on monsters will slow their movement, attack speed, and the rate at which they can evade your own attacks. That way, you can maim them properly.
yRJ6:
[Henson]
Remember, you must first learn ^6666CCLevel 2 Increase AGI^000000 if you want to be able to learn the Decrease AGI skill.
yhJ6:
[Henson]
The ^6666CCSignum Crusis^000000 skill lowers the Defense of monsters with the Undead or Dark properties. It has a wide range and can be quite powerful.
yxJ6:
[Henson]
However, it's a very difficult skill to use, and it has a relatively low success rate. But, do not despair if this skill is not successful all the time.
zBJ6:
[Henson]
When it does work, it will give you a great battle advantage. Remember, you will ^6666CCLevel 3 Demon Bane^000000 to acquire this skill.
zRJ6:
[Henson]
The ^6666CCPneuma^000000 allows you to generate a barrier that will block all long-range attacks in a certain range, creating a zone that will protect you from monsters that attack from a distance.
zhJ6:
[Henson]
In order to become ready to learn Pneuma, you must first completely master the ^6666CCWarp Portal^000000 skill.
zxJ6:
[Henson]
Nothing can escape the eyes of the Holy! ^6666CCRuwach^000000 allows you to see monsters, as well as other adventurers, that are hidden or invisible.
0BJ6:
[Henson]
Once you learn Ruwach, you will be able to learn the ^6666CCTeleport^000000 skill.
0RJ6:
[Henson]
First, you must learn the ^6666CCRuwach^000000 skill in order to learn how to Teleport.
0hJ6:
[Henson]
The ^6666CCTeleport^000000 skill teleports you to a random location in the field or city which you are currently in. Teleport will prove useful for quick escapes, but where you may end up is... unpredictable.
0xJ6:
[Henson]
Once the Teleport skill is mastered, you can Teleport to the latest Save Point that you have made with a Kafra Employee. I do not know why it is that way, but the Lord works in mysterious ways.
1BJ6:
[Henson]
When Teleport is mastered, you can also learn the ^6666CCWarp Portal^000000 skill. Ask Garnet if you wish to know more about Warp Portal.
1RJ6:
[Henson]
If you wish to understand more about an Acolyte or Priest skill, you are welcome to visit me at any time.

PJp7:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for  Dummies]^000000
So you want to open your own shop so that you can sell items to other players and make zeny?
P5p7:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
First, only certain job classes can open vending shops. As a Merchant, Blacksmith or Alchemist, you must first learn ^008B45Level 5 Enlarge Weight Limit^000000, and then learn the ^008B45Pushcart^000000 skill.
QJp7:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
When you have learned the Pushcart skill, you can go ahead and rent a Cart from a Kafra Employee. Once this cart is equipped, it won't disappear as long as you don't take it off.
QZp7:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
However, equipping a Cart reduces your movement speed. You can recover this movement speed by continuing to add skill points to the ^008B45Pushcart^000000 skill.
Qpp7:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
Now, this next part is very important. If you want to be able to sell what is inside your cart, you must learn ^008B45Level 3 Pushcart^000000 so that you can learn ^008B45Vending^000000, allowing you to sell items inside your cart.
Q5p7:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
Remember, only items inside your Cart can be sold with the Vending skill. Press the '^008B45Alt^000000' and '^008B45W^000000' keys to open the Cart Window labeled 'Rent a Cart Item.'
RJp7:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
You can drag and drop items from your Inventory Window into this Cart Window. You can also click the '^008B45items^000000' button in the Equipment Window (^008B45Alt^000000 + ^008B45Q^000000) to open the Cart Window.
RZp7:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
Now use the Vending skill. Two windows will pop up: ^008B45Available Items for Vending^000000 and ^008B45Vend a Shop^000000.
Rpp7:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
Drag and drop items from the ^008B45Available Items for Vending^000000 Window into the ^008B45Vend a Shop^000000 Window. Then, in the ^008B45Vend a Shop^000000 window, you may set prices and name your shop.
R5p7:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
After confirming the items and prices, click the 'OK' button. The ^008B45My Shop^000000 window will appear. Congratulations, you are now vending your items!
SJp7:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
When you close the ^008B45My Shop^000000 window, your shop will be closed. You can check the prices of your items in the ^008B45My Shop^000000 window, and your sales will be recorded in the chat window.
SZp7:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
When everything's sold out, the shop will automatically close.
Spp7:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
SuperNovices can learn all the skills needed to open vending shops, but none of the Kafra Employees will rent Carts to them. If only they could find somewhere to rent a cart...
TJp7:
^FF0000[Blacksmith Guide for Dummies]^000000
This is a useful guide detailing the process of Ore Refining and Weapon Crafting for Blacksmith job class characters.
UJp7:
^FF0000[Ore Refining for Dummies]^000000
Rough ores, like Iron Ore, and rough enchanted stones can be refined to create a higher quality metal or stone. Refining rough materials requires a ^0099FFMini Furnace^000000.
UZp7:
^FF0000[Ore Refining for Dummies]^000000
Several rough ores are also needed to create just one of a higher quality. When you think you have enough rough ores or stones of the same kind, double-click the Mini Furnace item in the Inventory window.
Upp7:
^FF0000[Ore Refining for Dummies]^000000
If you have the available materials and creation skills, a list of enchanted stones or metals that you can create will appear in a new window labeled ^0099FFItem List you can craft^000000.
U5p7:
^FF0000[Ore Refining for Dummies]^000000
However, if you don't have the necessary skills or materials, you will receive a message stating '^0099FFYou can't Create Items yet^000000.
VJp7:
^FF0000[Ore Refining for Dummies]^000000
Remember that there is a possibility that the refining process may fail. Also, be aware that a Mini Furnace will be used each time you double-click it, regardless of the end result.
VZp7:
^FF0000[Weapon Craft for Dummies]^000000
To create weapons, you must first learn the appropriate smithing skills, depending on the weapon you wish to create. The following is a list of Blacksmith weapon creation skills.
Vpp7:
^FF0000[Weapon Craft for Dummies]^000000
^0099FFSmith Dagger
Smith Sword
Smith Two-handed Sword
Smith Axe
Smith Mace
Smith Spear
Smith Knucklebrace^000000
V5p7:
^FF0000[Weapon Craft for Dummies]^000000
Every Weapon requires ^0099FFSteel^000000 and the consumption of one ^0099FFHammer^000000.
WJp7:
^FF0000[Weapon Craft for Dummies]^000000
When you double-click on a Hammer item in the Inventory Window, a new window labeled ^0099FFItem List you can craft^000000 will appear.
WZp7:
^FF0000[Weapon Craft for Dummies]^000000
A list of weapons that you are currently able to craft will appear. Clicking a Weapon in that list will show the items required for creation.
Wpp7:
^FF0000[Weapon Craft for Dummies]^000000
In that list window, there are 3 sockets into which you can insert additional items, such as Enchanted Stones or Star Crumbs, which enable you to enhance the smithed weapon.
W5p7:
^FF0000[Weapon Craft for Dummies]^000000
Afterwards, click the 'OK' button to confirm that you want to create the selected item. The materials required to create the weapon will be automatically consumed from your inventory.
XJp7:
^FF0000[Weapon Craft for Dummies]^000000
The chance of smithing success will depend on your character stats and skills, and other factors. If the smithing fails, any items used to create the new weapon will still be consumed. Good luck!

iiyA: We are the invincible single army!
iyyA:
[Marry Happy]
The ceremony will be conducted in the Kingdom of Rune Midgard.
His Majesty King Tristan III
will bless his beloved citizens
with his honorable presence
and he will also be the high priest who conducts the wedding ceremony.
jCyA:
[Marry Happy]
Although his Majesty is busy with daily tasks of running the kingdom,
he makes it a point to be present at Prontera Church
for newly wedded couples
to wish them eternal happiness.
This is really a blessing from His Majesty.
jSyA:
[Marry Happy]
A proposal for marriage is an honorable and serious thing.
Therefore, consider carefully before you go for it.
Once two people get married
they can never become separated again.
The couple must stay together forever
and only upon death will they part.
jiyA:
[Marry Happy]
Moreover, only a man can marry a woman
and only a woman can marry a man.
It is possible that
some will suggest marriage between the same sex or marriage to a monster.
Such suggestions... are not acceptable.
jyyA:
[Marry Happy]
If you have someone special,
why not make a marriage proposal?
I wish that all married couples
find true love and happiness within each other!
kCyA:
[Marry Happy]
First, I'll have to make sure whether the bride and bridegroom
had completed the application.
Of course, both of you must not have married before.
If you've already made the application,
please proceed to take the King's blessings after you've formed a party of two.
kSyA:
[Marry Happy]
When in the presence of the king,
the bridegroom shall speak first
and he will mention the bride's name.
You have to mention the correct name
or the ceremony cannot proceed.
kiyA:
[Marry Happy]
After that,
the bride will have to speak to the King.
His Majesty will ask
the name of the bridegroom.
So, answer it correctly.
kyyA:
[Marry Happy]
If both names are correct,
they will be able to exchange rings.
From that moment onwards,
the couple will stay together forever.
Well, maybe you will be rejected,
but don't be sad for it.
lCyA:
[Marry Happy]
If there are many couples
who want to get married,
please line up and talk to His Majesty in order.
Remember that it is impossible for His Majesty
to conduct several ceremonies at the same time.
lSyA:
[Marry Happy]
Last but not least
be quick to mention your partner's name.
The bride ^FF0000is given 3 minutes after 
the bridegroom has finished his speech^000000
or else
the ceremony will be cancelled.
lyyA: Easiest way to say my partner's name?
mCyA:
[Marry Happy]

weddings proceed as

you didn't understand,
you can ask me again.

[Marry Happy]

miyA:
[Marry Happy]

Press the 'Ctrl' button
and 'C' button at the same time to copy the name.
When you're asked to key in the name
press the 'shift' button
and 'insert' button at the same time
the name will be inserted easily.

Write the name of your partner

Then, answer 'Yes'.

button at the same time.

bMCE:
[Bonne]
Izlude is the satellite city of Prontera, capital of the Rune-Midgard kingdom.
bcCE:
[Bonne]
Izlude is key to our kingdom because of the Swordsman Association located here, as well as the fact that Izlude is in charge of protecting the Rune-Midgard coastline.
bsCE:
[Bonne]
I know, this bridge might look weak and fragile, but it is actually state of the art, built with the most sophisticated technology.
b8CE:
[Bonne]
No matter how strong storms may be, or how many people may stand on it, this bridge will NEEEEVER collapse.
cMCE:
[Bonne]
Please enjoy
your visit
here in Izlude.
csCE:
[Charfri]
Some people may think Izlude is just a satellite city of Prontera, and not really that important...
c8CE:
[Charfri]
But Izlude is a beautiful town right next to the ocean, as well as beautiful Byalan Island.
dMCE:
[Charfri]
You'll have to board on a ship at the port to get to Byalan Island. There are dangerous dungeons on that island, so don't go snooping around just anywhere.
dcCE:
[Charfri]
Though it is very beautiful, Byalan Island has a mysterious dungeon that extends deep under the sea.
dsCE:
[Charfri]
People who've actually been there have said that if you go deep enough, the dungeon actually descends underwater.
d8CE:
[Charfri]
Surprisingly, once you're underwater, you can breathe just like a fish. Maybe some kind of supernatural force is in effect.
eMCE:
[Charfri]
Ah...
The people who've seen the underwater view say it is so fantastic that they've kept dreaming of it ever since.
ecCE:
[Charfri]
But unfortunately, the monsters are too strong for ordinary people to merely go sight seeing there. Still, just once, I'd like to go down there...
e8CE:
[Cuskoal]
The Arena here is THE place for capable young people from all over the Rune-Midgard Kingdom to challenge themselves and test their skills.
fMCE:
[Cuskoal]
You can battle with monsters of differing levels. So, the number of stages you survive will be a testiment to your battle prowess.
fsCE:
[Cuskoal]
The pubs in Prontera are always full of people from local areas and from out-of-town. It can get pretty busy.
f8CE:
[Cuskoal]
It's a pretty good place to stop by for general information and to listen to rumors.
gMCE:
[Cuskoal]
So if you listen carefully, you just might get lucky and learn some very useful information for yourself.
gsCE:
[Dega]
Mt. Mjolnir, located north of Prontera, is a tough
and steep climb.
g8CE:
[Dega]
Aside from the dangers of the mountain itself, insanely vicious insects live there too. I mean, they'll just attack you for no reason.
hMCE:
[Dega]
If you ever want to visit somewhere past Mt. Mjolnir, then you prepare yourself for the challenge.  Or you could walk around it.
hcCE:
[Dega]
Some monsters in the world have the unique ability to sense mystical energy, and can detect Magic spells before they are cast.
hsCE:
[Dega]
Golem of the desert is one of them. Don't underestimate it due to its sluggishness...
h8CE:
[Dega]
If you try to cast magic near it, it will notice and saunter over to smash you. So you better watch out for Golem.
iMCE:
[Dega]
There's a very delightful place where you can find every
type of Poring.
icCE:
[Dega]
It's somewhere near the bridge connecting the forest and the desert, on the way to the city of Payon which is Southeast from here.
isCE:
[Dega]

i8CE:
[Dega]

jMCE:
[Dega]
Well, of course, they are all very cute, but Ghostring is an EXCEPTION. It is very very dangerous.
jcCE:
[Dega]
If you are lucky enough, you might even bump into Angelring, the Poring with Angel wings.
kcCE:
[Dega]
Ghostring is a grayish Poring that floats around in the air like a ghost. Just like other ghosts, physical attacks can't do any damage to it.
ksCE:
[Dega]
Those whose main attack methods are physical like Swordman and Archer might have to run for their lives when facing Ghostrings.
k8CE:
[Dega]

lMCE:
[Dega]

lcCE:
[Dega]
Angelrings are immune to Magic attacks. If people who can only attack with Magic face an Angelring, then it's time for
them to run.

However, as the balance of nature has changed, the monsters have inevitably returned. Not too many people know this, but most monsters were gentle creatures at one time. It's sad, really...
YnCP:
[Estheres]
Ah yes, Jellopy.
It seems that almost every monster around is composed of Jellopy. But is it just a crystallization made by some monsters, or is it... More?
Y3CP:
[Estheres]
From our research of ancient monsters and studies of recently discovered monsters, it seems that that traces of Jellopy cannot be found in stronger beasts.
ZHCP:
[Estheres]
Still, may of us believe that there might be some relation to Jellopy and monsters, although it may be hard to believe that there is any.

[Estheres]
It's possible that Jellopy may be linked to a monster's personality and strength. So, if you mixed Jellopy with something, you'd create a stronger monster.

[Estheres]
Of course, doing that kind of experimentation just seems dangerous. You might be able to unleash some really scary monsters into the world...
aHCP:

the one and only Inn
in the city of Geffen.

Your respawn point

please come again.
bHCP:
[Employee Cena]
Thank you.

enjoy your rest~

AXyS:
[Lady]
A long time ago,
when Payon was still
developing, many of the
villagers lived in poverty.
AnyS:
[Lady]
Many families had to struggle to survive, and often could not even afford to properly bury their dead. Some people threw their dead into the cave near the village.
A3yS:
[Lady]
So in that cave, it is said that there are many walking Zombies,
the dead who cannot rest in peace and are unable to pass on to the next world.
BHyS:
[Lady]
The Zombies, upon sensing the warmth of a human, begin to assault them, but that doesn't mean these Undead hold a grudge against
the living.
BXyS:
[Lady]
Their rotten bodies can't leave the cold, dark and damp cave, so it's instinctual for them to attack warmth which would speed up the decomposition of their bodies.
BnyS:
[Lady]
The Zombies in the Payon Cave
may be spooky, but their story
is also kind of tragic.
CHyS:
[Young Man]
From your attire,
I can see that you
are a stranger here.
Welcome to Payon.
CXyS:
[Young Man]
You must be a well-experienced fighter, otherwise you'd never be able to arrive here after passing the steep, mountainous areas and dangerous creatures surrounding this city.
CnyS:
[Young Man]
I'm no expert at fighting, but someone once told me that sheer strength alone won't be able to win some battles.
C3yS:
[Young Man]
Sometimes, you may encounter creatures protected by a hard-shell that don't be damaged by physical attacks. Only psychic power, like Magic, can easily defeat such creatures.
DHyS:
[Young Man]
Of course, not everyone can study magic. The point is that you should keep different kinds of friends and comrades close to you, as you can't possibly handle every situation by yourself.
DXyS:
[Young Man]
I remember the story my dearly departed grandfather has told me.
DnyS:
[Young Man]
It's about this Amulet that possesses an Evil Power.
With it, you could awaken
the Dead from the Grave.
D3yS:
[Young Man]
Well, I'm not sure if it's true or not. But, I wonder, what would happen if I used it to summon
my grandfather from the other realm....
EHyS:
[?]
^3299CCNever think
of such a thing...
My son.^000000
EXyS:
[Young Man]
EEEEEEK-!
What was that?!
G-grandpa...?
FXyS:
[Pub Lady]
This place is always bustling with busy people. Little Novices come and go to become Archers, and everyone else is buying arrows while I have to stay here in this small shop.
FnyS:
[Pub Lady]
And I'm sick and tired of making this noodle soup. I have to shower all the time so I can get rid of the smell. And it's not so easy
to get rid of.
F3yS:
[Pub Lady]
I feel so...
Bored.
And lonely...
GHyS:
[Pub Lady]
Where I can find the right person, a hot and sexy hunk who can take me away from here? Um, hey mister, are you listening?
GXyS:
[Pub Lady]
Where I can find the right person, a cute, yet hard-bodied hunk who can take me away from here?
Um, hey lady, are
you listening?
GnyS:
[Pub Lady]
The old fortune teller told me that I'd have great luck in the near future! But what's wrong with me? I'm just living day to day. Maybe I'm just dumb and wishy-washy.
G3yS:
[Pub Lady]
I'm so sorry,
I've said too much.
Now I'm just acting stupid.
I'm sorry you had to listen
to all that.
HHyS:
[Pub Lady]
So...
How may I help you?
HXyS: Have you ever heard of Zombies?
IHyS:
[Pub Lady]
Of course I've
heard of Zombies!
This is Payon, after all.
Zombies are the walking
Undead, and you can easily
find them around here.
IXyS:
[Pub Lady]
I hear that they fear holiness, so Archers prefer to use arrow made out of silver, a holy metal, against them.
InyS:
[Pub Lady]
Legend says that the chief of this town used silver arrows against Zombies that used to be his brethren in order to release their souls so that they may rest in peace.
I3yS:
[Pub Lady]
We believe that exorcising
Zombies in this way will lead them peacefully to the afterlife. Their souls no longer need to anguish.
JHyS:
[Pub Lady]
You might not share our beliefs, but my grandfather was one of the Undead. I appreciate that the chief was able to free him from being bound to the world of the living.
JXyS:
[Pub Lady]
Oh! Our fortune teller is a really extraordinary person. Well, she doesn't hang around here as
much as she used to do.
JnyS:
[Pub Lady]
She used to stay here to tell fortunes for our patrons, but ever since the chief recognized her talents, she now stays in the Central Palace. So you'd better go there if you want to see her.
J3yS:
[Pub Lady]
You...
needs some
booze, eh?
Don't we all?
KHyS:
[Pub Lady]
But I'm so sorry, we sold out.
And we can't afford to prepare alcohol anymore because of the hostile creatures out there. But please come again later. I'm sorry for the inconvenience.
KXyS:
[Pub Lady]
Have a nice
day, dearie.
KnyS:
[Pub Lady]
^666666*Sob*^000000
When will I be romanced
by my perfectly formed,
yet well read man?
LHyS:
[Guardsman]
This is the Central Palace of Payon. This place is open to the public, but in accordance with our laws, you must behave in an orderly fashion once inside.
LXyS:
[Guardsman]
In the interest of protecting the peace, we will disarm your equipment once you enter.
Your cooperation is
much appreciated.
MHyS:
[Chief Guardsman]
I can see that you are not one of the Payon locals. I would just like to remind you to conduct yourself in an orderly manner. Remember,
you are a guest here.
MXyS:
[Chief Guardsman]
In the interest of protecting the public peace, I will disarm your equipment. Thank you for your cooperation.
M3yS:
[Woman]
Welcome to Payon.
You must have had
a hard time getting
through the Payon Forest.
How was your trip?
NHyS:
[Woman]

NXyS:
[Woman]
 To be honest, things are getting tough because of all those monsters. ^666666*Sigh...*^000000

OHyS: Oooh! I didn't notice before, but you look pretty strong beneath all of that feminine charm.
OXyS:
[Woman]
Hey, I know of a good place for you to hunt. It just so happens that there's a cave in the middle of Payon.
OnyS:
[Woman]

PXyS: That's a nice dress you're wearing~
PnyS:
[Woman]
Oh come on, don't be a coward.

P3yS:
[Woman]
Oh don't worry about any preparations. There's a Tool Dealer right in front of the cave, so you can purchase anything you need from my husban, er, that guy~
QHyS:
[Woman]
Oh hohohoho!
So you've noticed?
I hear this is the
latest trend in Prontera
these days.
QXyS:
[Woman]
Most of the women in this town don't know anything about fashion! My husband bought this for me as
a present. He makes quite a lot of money, you know. Hohohoho~
QnyS:
[Jim's Mother]
Oh boy~
There she goes again.
Without a doubt, that
woman is the town gossip.
Q3yS:
[Jim's Mother]
Please don't judge the rest
of the people living in Payon by her behavior. She's the only loudmouth. I guess she's just too excited about what the fortune teller told her.
RXyS:

a nice dinner~
RnyS:

beating the boys away with a stick...

SXyS:
[Jim's Mother]
Oh yes...
There's an extraordinary fortune teller in the Central Palace of Payon. The more Zeny you pay her, the better fortune you'll get!
SnyS:
[Jim's Mother]
She told me
I would meet
a nice guy this month.
Hohohoho~
S3yS:
[Jim's Mother]
Mmmm...?

any time to stay
and chit-chat with me?

YnyS:
[Archer Zakk]
Our chief lives in the Central Palace. I guess you can say that he's the spiritual guide of Payon.

[Archer Zakk]

ZHyS:
[Archer Zakk]
But now he
seems old and weak.

of battle, where he'd never miss
a target.
ZXyS:
[Archer Zakk]
I admire our chief
from the bottom
of my heart.
ZnyS:
[Archer Zakk]
You don't know
what a motormouth is...?
Z3yS:
[Archer Zakk]
Motormouth
Noun. Some fool who chatters
way too much about stuff that doesn't really matter and doesn't know when to stop.
aHyS:
[Archer Zakk]
But yeah, my pal is not only
a legend at archery, he's also well known for how long he's let that mouth of his run.
aXyS:
[Archer Zakk]
Anyway, my pal Wolt doesn't have
a place of his own, so he stays at the Inn. Why don't you go and meet him? He's actually an okay guy if you can stand all the chatter.
a3yS:
[Archer Wolt]
Archers should
practice as much
as they can. Otherwise,
they'll never become experts.

[Archer Wolt]
Oh, hey there!
I'm Wolt the Archer,
but, erm, you can
just call me 'Wolt.'

[Archer Wolt]

you tend to spend a lot of your
time in idleness?
cHyS:
[Archer Wolt]
Ooh. That's good. In fact, that's great! If only all of us Archers had that kind of attitude. If you have time to just sit around, then you have the time to go out and practice!

[Archer Wolt]
Yeah...
As Archers, we kind of look
down on people who slack off
on the training.

[Archer Wolt]
If you don't work hard, then you'll end up being a horrible Archer. No one can depend on your aim!
I mean, nobody!
c3yS:
[Archer Wolt]
Did you ask how we go about
our training? Well, the Archers of Payon don't have much time to just play around with their Bows.
I guess we go out and
engage in actual fighting.
dHyS:
[Archer Wolt]
So we just carry out Bows wherever we go, and spend all day looking for monsters to kill. Oh, and after we find some monsters, we
kill them of course. That almost goes without saying.
dXyS: I guess you'd need a good Bow.
d3yS:
[Archer Wolt]
That's right!
An Archer depends
on the strength
of his Bow!
eHyS:
[Archer Wolt]
Bows constructed in Payon
are the greatest on this continent! They are light and stout, made out of high quality tree Trunks from Payon Forest!
eXyS:
[Archer Wolt]
The quality of the wood often determines the quality of the Bow. My lil' sweety was made out of a walnut tree, and is strong enough to bear thousands of pounds
of force.
enyS:
[Arche Wolt]
Oh, oh! And my Bow's stylish as well. It comes in a sophisticated ebony color, and I just look so cool and heroic while I'm killing monsters~!

[Archer Wolt]
Oh, and the trees in Payon Forest are famous for the quality of their wood. But then, more and more of them have been turning into monsters. Is this the work of evil forces?!

[Archer Wolt]
It's a pity because the tree monsters used to be beautiful, majestic trees. But then it's okay if we kill them, so that we can make Bows out of their wood.
fXyS:
[Archer Wolt]
And then we use these Bows to kill even more tree monsters... And then make more wood! Mwahahahaha! It's an endless cycle!
f3yS:
[Archer Wolt]
Yeah...

Monsters are everywhere,
can you believe it?
gHyS:
[Archer Wolt]
Do you understand
why the Archer Village
was built where it is?

[Archer Wolt]
To the West, near Archer Village, you'll see Payon Cave. Inside the cave, an enormous amount of monster endlessly spawn without showing any sign of slowing down.
gnyS:
[Archer Wolt]
We Archers are here to protect our territory against them, as ordered by our honorable chief!
hXyS: Oh man, I hate this town!
hnyS:
[Archer Wolt]
If you head North
of town, you'll find
Payon Cave.
h3yS:
[Archer Wolt]
Once inside, you'll encounter all sorts lots of ugly monsters. Like those nasty looking Bats, and
those Zombies...
iHyS:
[Archer Wolt]
If we let them out of that place, they'd run all over Payon! So, we gotta get in there and clean that place up of monsters.
iXyS:
[Archer Wolt]
But since these monsters endlessly respawn, sometimes I feel like we're wasting our time and energy for nothing...
inyS:
[Archer Wolt]
Whoa...
Alright, I think yet my mouth run
a marathon again. I better let you go. There's lots of training to do, and plenty of monsters to kill!
i3yS:
[Archer Wolt]
Our chief? Ah, he's such a swell guy. Then again, he's always scolds me for talking too much.
jHyS:
[Archer Wolt]
He always working to make sure
that Payon is safe from harm. Lately, I've been worried since he hasn't been coming out the Palace lately. That might be a bad sign.
jXyS:
[Archer Wolt]
A bad sign of what, I'm not really sure. There could be problems with Payon, or maybe he's got something he needs to handle on his own. Anyway, there's always guards in his room for some reason.
jnyS:
[Archer Wolt]
Heh heh heh~
I'll get in trouble if he knows
I told an outsider know too much about his affairs. Oh well! It's too late. I already told you! There's no use regretting it!
j3yS:
[Archer Wolt]
But...
It's not too late for me to just shut my mouth. Keep it closed. Shutting up now. Quiet as a mouse. Seeya later~!
kHyS:
[Archer Wolt]
Hmm...?
And you don't?
What better practice
than the real, honest
to goodness thing?
kXyS:
[Archer Wolt]
Though, you may have a point
there. I mean, you should be able to practice without having to suffer serious consequences.
You know, like death.
knyS:
[Archer Wolt]
But we've gotta make do
do with what we've got!
An Archer's life is
endless training!
Endless practice!
k3yS:
[Archer Wolt]
Hm...?
Are you tired of me repeating the same thing over and over again?
Oh, just bear with me. Think of it as practicing your patience~
lHyS:
[Archer Wolt]
Eh...
I guess it's important
to set aside time to rest.
lXyS:
[Archer Wolt]
But it's also a good idea to set aside time for practicing and training, and practicing and training!
lnyS:
[Archer Wolt]
And it's a very bad idea to rest when you should be alert, or well, when you're supposed to be doing something else.
l3yS:
[Archer Wolt]
That reminds me of the time
I set fire to my house during the holidays. It was an accident, of course, but boy, were my folks angry!
mHyS:
[Archer Wolt]
Hahahaha~
It all started when I decided to take a bath. Here, in Payon, we use the old style baths, so we need to make a fire to heat the water. Cold baths are just so uncomfortable.
mXyS:
[Archer Wolt]
But nice, warm baths are veeeery comfortable. That was probably the best bath I had in my life! It was so comfortable, I fell asleep.
mnyS:
[Archer Wolt]
But while I was sleeping,
I guess I didn't notice the fire reach the floor, walls and ceiling! Luckily, I was in a tub full of water, so I was okay.
m3yS:
[Archer Wolt]
I would've gotten help if it weren't for the fact that the fire had burned my clothes while I was napping. So, of course, I couldn't just run around town in the nude.
nHyS:
[Archer Wolt]
So...
I just sat in the water for about an hour, completely naked, and yelling 'Help me,' until someone could hear me.
nXyS:
[Archer Wolt]
But, it turned out that no one could hear me. Luckily, our roof caved in and totally demolished our walls so that my screams could finally reach passerby. And it was in that way that I survived.
nnyS: Um, what's the point of that story?
n3yS: I guess I better not get lazy then.
oXyS:
[Archer Wolt]
Oh...
Umm...
You mean, like,
the moral of the story?
onyS:
[Archer Wolt]
Resting during the right times is perfectly fine. Just don't go and take a break when you shouldn't. That kind of behavior would make anyone in our town angry!
o3yS:
[Archer Wolt]
Our chief is especially annoyed by that kind of irresponsible attitude. I guess, around here, only the town drunkard subscribes to that kind of policy.
p3yS:
[Archer Wolt]
He always working to make sure
that Payon is safe from harm. Lately, I've been worried since he hasn't been coming out the Palace lately. That might be a bad sign...
qHyS:
[Archer Wolt]
But...
It's not too late for me to just shut my mouth. Complete silence. I'm not even opening my mouth. Starting right about... Now!
Seeya later~!
qXyS:
[Archer Wolt]
You know...
The guy in the pub.
Loud, and obnoxious
and annoying to liste--
qnyS:
[Archer Wolt]
Hmm...?
What's that look for?
Anyway, when I have
some spare cash, I try
to buy him a drink.
q3yS:
[Archer Wolt]
Still...
It's not a good
idea to drink so much.
Or as much as he does...
rnyS:
[Archer Wolt]
Oh good~!
I guess you got
the point of my story!
r3yS:
[Archer Wolt]
We, as Archers, put a lot of importance on training and practice, so we kind of look
down on people who aren't
diligent at all.
sHyS:
[Archer Wolt]
Still...
I have to admit that, at heart,
I'm a pretty lazy guy. I guess it's pretty amazing that someone like
me can even be an Archer!
sXyS:
[Archer Wolt]
In any case,
whatever you do
in life, do it
with passion!
s3yS:
[Archer Joe]
Payon!
Such a wonderful
place! Superb Bows
and skillful Archers!
tHyS:
[Archer Joe]
Hey you~!
Have you heard
of famous Payon?
uHyS:
[Archer Joe]
Oh! You the man!

uXyS: So, you like this place, huh?
u3yS:
[Archer Joe]
Yes! I love this place!
I love this city so much,
I've even been doing research on it! If there's anything you wanna know about Payon, please ask me!
vHyS: The people wear unique clothing here.
vXyS: What's the building in the middle of town?
vnyS: Who's that guy drinking over there?
wHyS:
[Archer Joe]
Yes, I agree.
You must know this place used to be isolated because of the thick forests and the mountainous area.
wXyS:
[Archer Joe]
Because of that, the Payon developed a culture of its own, which is quite different than that of the rest of Rune-Midgard.
wnyS:
[Archer Joe]
This garment is traditional Payon clothing! Why don't you try wearing one? It's very comfortable~
w3yS:
[Archer Joe]

xHyS:
[Archer Joe]
I'd like to go there sometime, and see what it's like on the inside!
xXyS:
[Archer Joe]

xnyS:
[Archer Joe]

x3yS:
[Archer Joe]

yHyS:
[Archer Joe]
Well, when you

yXyS:
[Archer Joe]
Why are

to be bashful around me~
y3yS:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
Nice to meet you.
I am called Vuicokk.
I am a scholar in the Monster Research organization of the Rune-Midgard Kingdom. Do you have any questions about monsters?
z3yS:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
Payon is located deep inside the forest where it can easily be attacked by hordes of monsters. Monsters also come from the dangerous cave located near town.
0HyS:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
Since Undead monsters roam the Payon Cave, it has attracted the attention of the monster academic world. My job here is to analyze their characteristics.
0XyS:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
What is most remarkable of the Undead monsters in Payon is their origin Most of them used to be citizens of Payon!
0nyS:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
However, these souls are
unable to rest in peace and still wander about as Undead bound
to this world.
03yS:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
These monsters cannot be classified with other monsters that have mutated from living creatures, so our wise and benevolent ruler, King Tristram III, has taken a great interest in Payon's Undead.
1HyS:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
After all, some of these
Undead used to belong to
the Rune-Midgard Kingdom.
1XyS:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
As his subjects,
King Tristram III
feels some responsbility
to release their souls.
1nyS:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
His Majesty has been supporting
us in our search to discover how to eliminate all of the Undead in this world. We will try to accomplish this goal as soon as we
possibly can.
13yS:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
For the safety of our people,
for the sake of their bereaved families, and in accordance with King Tristram III's order, we must succeed!
2HyS:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
As you may well know,
monsters have been endlessly spawning in this world, and the threat of their attacks is grows greater every day.
2XyS:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
In response to this,
 the Monster Research
Organization has been formed.
2nyS:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
Talented people around the world have joined forces in an effort to deduce the origin of monsters, and a way to eliminate them once and for all.
23yS:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
Of course, it's not
as easy as you would may believe. Many have sacrificed their lives in the pursuit of this knowledge.
3HyS:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]

3XyS:
[Monster Scholar Vuicokk]
^666666*Ahem*^000000 My apologies, I get too excited sometimes. But if you happen to meet other scholars such as myself, please treat them well. Our jobs are very difficult!
33yS:
[Guard]
Hey...
Hey...!
Show your respect

waOb:
[Kinsey]
What does a man have to do to get a stiff drink around here? I mean, there are absolutely no good bars in Alberta!
wqOb:
[Kinsey]
 Well, the alcohol in the pub here is second rate, but I gotta admit, it's got a great atmosphere.
w6Ob:
[Kinsey]
In fact, this old man is always there, telling stories about Turtle Island! But we're not sure if he's been there, or if he's just that drunk.
xqOb:
[Kinsey]
Whoa...
Hey, your eyes just lit up right when I said 'Turtle Island!' Hmm, let me try that again.
yaOb:
[Kinsey]
Ah...
You must be an adventurer. It seems like you really wanna learn more about that place, huh?
yqOb:
[Kinsey]
Why don't you look around near the pub, and look for that old man? He's usually pretty drunk, and speaks nonsense, but he might have something to say to you.
y6Ob:
[Kinsey]
Oh, and um, I've been in his room before. He leaves some sort of letter lying around the table that has something to do with his Turtle Island stories.
zKOb:
[Kinsey]
But if he asks for you to buy him a drink, I wouldn't do it. He's got like, three extra livers or something, so he'll drink you to bankruptcy.
zaOb:
[Kinsey]
Yeah, I guess it's pretty cool listening to his stories. But it would be even cooler if I could hear them in a better drinking establishment.
zqOb:
[Kinsey]
I mean, they don't even serve a 'Boogieman,' much less a 'Cobo.' It's getting harder and harder to find those fine, fine specialty drinks.
0aOb:
[Grandpa Turtle]
There isn't one decent drinking establishment in all of Alberta! But then again, why did I drink so much? Hmm...
1qOb:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Well, there's a lot of folklore about that place. Some folk say that there's a mountain of treasure there.
16Ob:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Others folk say a potion that can prolong your lifespan can be found somewhere in Turtle Island. But nobody really knows for sure.
2KOb:
[Grandpa Turtle]
But I'm sure that Turtle Island does exist, and that something wonderful can be found there.
2aOb:
[Grandpa Turtle]
But only someone with a good heart that's eager for adventure should be able to go to that kind of place.
3KOb:
Ha ha ha~!
I like the shine in your eye, my boy! I can see a little bit of myself in those eyes. Yes...
3aOb:
Ha ha ha~!
No use hiding the glint in your eyes, my dear! It's adventure you wish for, that much I can tell...
3qOb:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Tell me...
Have you heard of a man named ^3355FFJornadan Niliria^000000? He, and a group of ten other men actually found Turtle Island!
36Ob:
[Grandpa Turtle]
^3355FFJornadan Niliria^000000 was a man of strength and conviction. He and his crew gathered every clue they could about Turtle Island.
4KOb:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Even after learning all that they could, much of their voyage relied on their hope and faith that the Turtle Island legend was true...
4aOb:
[Grandpa Turtle]
After a long, arduous journey, their efforts were rewarded, and they landed on Turtle Island!
4qOb:
[Grandpa Turtle]
However, it gets more complicated after that. I hear Niliria's crew had great difficulty getting back home for some reason.
46Ob:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Heh heh...
If you want to learn more, why don't you go to the eastern end of the Alberta port? There's a scholar there that knows more of this story.
5KOb:
[Grandpa Turtle]
He could probably shed more light on the subject of Turtle Island's legend.
5aOb:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Ah, one more thing! Look around that scholar and you should find his ^3355FFJournal^000000. I promise that it will be an interesting read.
5qOb:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Ah...
The fire of youth!
When the winds die, may your dreams fill your sails~ Good luck to you!
6KOb:
[Grandpa Turtle]
I may not know much, but I won't talk to anyone motivated solely by greed. Go home!
6aOb:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Well...
If you go to eastern side of the Alberta port, you should find an old ferryboatman.
6qOb:
[Grandpa Turtle]
His name is ^3355FFGotanblue^000000. I believe he may know a way to Turtle Island. Heh heh, good luck~
7KOb:
[Grandpa Turtle]
My, that place is difficult to find and even more difficult to travel to. You're sure you want to go? I would love to give you some advice, but I feel so dizzy after drinking so much...
7aOb:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Ho ho ho...
Why don't you talk to a chubby little sailor I know named ^3355FFGotanblue^000000. You can find him loitering on one of the Alberta ports.
7qOb:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Tell him that I sent you, and he may tell you more about Turtle Island. He may even know how to get there~
8KOb:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Oooh...
Even at this age...
I don't understand
how I can drink so much...
8qOb:
[Gotanblue]
Heh...
Your eyes...
I can tell you're curious about Turtle Island. I guess you must have been talking to that drunken old man!
86Ob: Do you know about Turtle Island?
9aOb:
[Gotanblue]
Turtle Island...?
Well, first I think it's fair to warn you that Turtle Island took the lives of my buddies. That's right, I was part of ^3355FFJornadan Niliria^000000's crew.
9qOb:
[Gotanblue]
We wanted to find out if the legends about that island were true, so we left everything behind to learn the truth.
96Ob:
[Gotanblue]
Jornadan Niliria was one of the greatest treasure hunters ever, and he gathered men for his crew from around the globe. I'm proud to say that each member of our crew was the best in his field.
+KOb:
[Gotanblue]
I happened to be the best at navigating. I was only twenty, but I was still invited to his team. It was such an honor to be accepted as an equal amongst these great men.
+aOb:
[Gotanblue]
Anyway, our biggest clue about Turtle Island's location hinted that it was near Alberta, so our voyage began from here.
+qOb:
[Gotanblue]
We sailed day and night, drifting for weeks, until one day, we were surrounded by an incredibly thick fog. We had no idea of which direction we were going and the mist wouldn't clear.
+6Ob:
[Gotanblue]
But none of us had any regrets and we just kept moving onward. There would be no turning back!
/KOb:
[Gotanblue]
Finally, a coral reef sudden appeared and we couldn't steer away from it. Our ship was critically damaged. But when the fog cleared, we saw that we had finally arrived at Turtle Island! It was real!
/aOb:
[Gotanblue]
After we made camp on shore and explored the island, we learned something quite remarkable.
/qOb:
[Gotanblue]
There was a man who had actually made it to Turtle Island before us. His records, however, never reached Rune-Midgard. He was a great swordmaster known simply as ^3355FFOne^000000.
/6Ob:
[Gotanblue]
According to his records, he had traveled alone to find Turtle Island and made it by himself. But we couldn't find any sign of him anywhere...
AKSb:
[Gotanblue]
As we explored Turtle Island further, we learned that not only was it abundant with treasure, but that it also held an item of great interest.
AaSb:
[Gotanblue]
From the first explorer's record, some kind of amazing ^3355FFjewel fragment^000000 was mentioned.
AqSb:
[Gotanblue]
He had traveled to Turtle Island with the purpose of discovering secrets to the sword arts, and stumbled upon a jewel he claimed was the most beautiful in the world.
A6Sb:
[Gotanblue]
By the ^3355FFOne^000000's records, we were able to thoroughly explore all to be seen on Turtle Island. However...
BKSb:
[Gotanblue]
Even after months of searching, we could never find a trace of the jewel fragment. Eventually, we had to give up on our search.
BaSb:
[Gotanblue]
Finally, we packed our things to leave the island. But then, as we were traveling at sea, we encountered a thick, blinding fog once again.
BqSb:
[Gotanblue]
We spent a month trying to steer through that mist. When we finally sailed out of that mist, we saw that we had arrived at the other side of Turtle Island!
B6Sb:
[Gotanblue]
Our spirits were crushed!! We tried again and again to leave that place, and spent nearly a year trying to leave but we kept winding up at Turtle Island's shores.
CKSb:
[Gotanblue]
As we struggled with the fog, we lost our comrades one by one. In the end, Jornadan, the drunken old man you met, and myself were the only ones who were able to return home to Alberta.
CaSb:
[Gotanblue]
We were the only ones who did not give in to despair, and doggedly held onto our hopes. Still, it was by pure luck that we found a way back to Rune-Midgard.
CqSb:
[Gotanblue]
Well, that's my story. You know, if you want to learn more about Turtle Island, why don't you speak to the scholar on the eastern port of Alberta?
C6Sb:
[Gotanblue]
Heh heh...
I'm sure he can tell give you details that even I wouldn't be able to provide...
DKSb:
[Gotanblue]
After my story of Turtle Island, you're still not afraid of going? I'm impressed! Alright then...
DaSb:
[Gotanblue]
If you wish for me to guide you there, I will charge you 10,000 zeny. I'm the only navigator that can guide you there and back safely.
EKSb:
[Gotanblue]
Alright!!
You've made your choice! With my experience, we will arrive without fail! I appreciate your spirit!
EqSb:
[Gotanblue]
Hmmm...
Sorry, but you don't have enough zeny. I hope you understand that I can let my expertise and experience be undervalued...
E6Sb:
[Gotanblue]
Alright then...
Well, if the spirit of adventure should happen to grab you, I will be here waiting.
FaSb:
[Gotanblue]
Come back whenever you feel you're ready to hear my story, will you?
FqSb:
[Gotanblue]
Ahhhh...!
Just look at that ocean! It covers the earth as far as the eye can see. Tell me that's not one of the most beautiful things you've ever seen...
F6Sb:
[Gotanblue]
Do you want
to return
to Alberta?
GaSb:
[Gotanblue]
Heh heh...
I certainly hope you've found what you were looking for. Alright, I guess there's always a time for an adventurer to return home...
HKSb:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Every single place
has its own unique
smells, sights and sounds.
HaSb:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Even the great, ever expanding sky that's shared by all the peoples of the earth looks strange when you're in a new and foreign land.
HqSb:
[Jornandan Niliria]
Heh heh...
Just like my
time on Turtle Island.
Hah Hah Hah~
IqSb:
[Jornadan Niliria]
It's almost silly, but Turtle Island was named simply because it's shaped just like a turtle.
I6Sb:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Now, Turtle Island is surrounded by a dense fog. When we were first stuck in it, a lot of us believed it was the result of a curse, or some kind of magic.
JKSb:
[Jornadan Niliria]
But in actuality, the fog is the result of a natural phenomenon. It's created by a waterfall inside a cave located on Turtle Island's coast.
JaSb:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Heh heh...
Once you attain understanding, the truth becomes so simple. I guess confusion and fear is the fog that clouds your judgment, your path on life.
JqSb:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Believe it or not, I too used to fear the dangers of Turtle Island. But now that I understand most of its secrets, I look at my experiences at Turtle Island with fondness.
J6Sb:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Still, there is one thing I haven't yet uncovered. The ^3355FFunknown jewel fragment^000000.
KKSb:
[Jornandan Niliria]
So, until I find it, I'll keep researching and learn as much as I can until I do. Ha ha ha ha~!
KaSb:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Hmm...?
You've heard of me?
KqSb:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Ah...
I suppose that you know about my treasure hunting days, and probably about Turtle Island.
K6Sb:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Well, as you can see, I'm a little older now. These old bones aren't what they used to be.
LKSb:
[Jornadan Niliria]
But perhaps, someday, if my research bears fruit, I'll venture out once more and seek the one treasure I've never found...
LaSb:
[Jornadan Niliria]
When you want to discover the truth, never give in to despair. If you never give up your search, the answer will come to you.
MKSb:
[Jornadan Niliria]
By the way, I'm pretty hungry. Why doesn't Alberta have any good restaurants?! I hear they have good dimsum in Kunlun...
