xKSb:
[Terrified Voice]
What's that noise?!
M-M-Mudasamu!
Protect me!
xqSb:
[Takuyaka]
Where did all my men go?!
This is horrible~!
x6Sb:
[Takuyaka]
Oh...
*Whew!*
Finally, another person.
Tell me who you are!
y6Sb: First, tell me who you are.
zKSb:
[Takuyaka]
How dare you speak to me in that tone! Don't you know who I am?! I'm Takuyaka, leader of the Security Knights of Alberta! Kobolds and Porings quiver in fear when they hear my name...
zaSb:
[Takuyaka]
So tell me the truth! You came here for treasure, didn't you?! You want it all for yourself! You bastard! Now get off this island! Go, shoo!
zqSb:
[Takuyaka]
{}?
Well, your name sounds better than mine. And you have more hair on your head as well. Hmmm...
z6Sb:
[Takuyaka]
Do you have anything to give me? You know, some food or zeny? It's not like I really need it, it's just... Oh bother. Never mind. Perhaps we'll meet later.
0KSb:
[Takuyaka]
I've heard that many treasures can be found on Turtle Island. If I can take enough home, I'll be rich! Well, we're supposed to rescue lost adventurers too, but whatever. As leader, I can do whatever I want!
0aSb:
[Takuyaka]
However, we're totally lost. Meaning we can't find any treasure or even rescue any people. Grrr...! Where are my useless soldiers! I've probably spoiled them with too much food!
0qSb:
[Takuyaka]
If you see any of them, tell them they must assemble here! Alright?!
06Sb:
[Takuyaka]
Me? I'm Takuyaka. A tall, dark, handsome, and dashing leader, as well as a fearsome knight! I have come to save the foolish people of Alberta that have come seeking treasure on Turtle Island.
1qSb:
[Takuyaka]
Anyway, we came here with the purest of intents. But right when we arrived, we were attacked by monsters! Because of the confusion from all the fighting, my soldiers were scattered.
16Sb:
[Takuyaka]
Mudasamu!
Why is this
happening to me!!!!
2KSb:
[Mudasamu]
Huh...!
Why should you
be surprised,
you chubby dwarf?
2qSb:
[Mudasamu]
My name is Mudasamu...
Second in command of the
Alberta Security Knights.
26Sb:
[Mudasamu]
We've come here to rescue treasure hunters that might be in trouble. However, our leader is this porky specimen right next to me. So I guess I foresaw that this mission would fail.
3KSb:
[Mudasamu]
Basically, our leader was so distracted by the idea of finding treasure himself that we've lost our men. It's bad enough that he's a fat slob, but he's a greedy slob too!
3aSb:
[Takuyaka]
Hey, Mudasamu!
Are you talking
about me?!
3qSb:
[Mudasamu]
No, fat one,
we're not
talking about you.
36Sb:
[Mudasamu]
*Sigh...*
I better be paid
overtime for
putting up with this.
4aSb:
[?]
Where are they?
Oh hey! You're an adventurer, aren't you? Do you know where my comrades are?
5qSb:
[Passats]
My name is Passats, a proud Security Knight of Alberta. We've obtained some information that some people came here to seek treasure.
56Sb:
[Passats]
Our task here is to save people, but when we arrived on Turtle Island, we were attacked by a mob of monsters! So we all got scattered.
6KSb:
[Passats]
Now I'm all alone. If you find anyone else in my unit, would you let them know?
6aSb:
[Passats]
Ah well...
Well, if you happen to find anyone else in my unit, would you let them know where I am?
6qSb:
[Passat]
Oh, and if you find our leader, kick his butt, will you? It's so fat, there's no way you can miss.
7KSb:
[Passats]
There are a lot of stories about the amazing wealth that can be found on this island. However, everyone assumed that it was impossible to find Turtle Island.
7aSb:
[Passats]
But then, the problem began when some navigator actually knew the way to Turtle Island. I think he'll take just about anybody for 10,000 zeny!
7qSb:
[Passats]
So anyway, some of the people of Alberta have been foolishly coming here, hoping to find treasure. But of course, they can't fight monsters.
76Sb:
[Passats]
So now we're here in order to seek out towners in trouble, and send them safely back home. Of course, now it seems that we also need rescuing...
86Sb:
[Passats]
Oh, don't be angry. I just drank too much vodka! Before we arrived I was still unconscious and when I finally sobered up, I was here. I'm so embarrassed~
9aSb:
[Jayprocat]
Oh? Are you a civilian? Nice to meet you. I'm a mighty Security Knight of Alberta, Jayprocat.
+KSb:
[Jayprocat]
Well...
We're supposed to protect the people of Alberta. That's our job as proud Security Knights.
+aSb:
[Jayprocat]
So when a bunch of them caught treasure fever and started coming here, we came to rescue them. Anyway, that was the plan.
+qSb:
[Jayprocat]
It turns out that by some joke by fate, our leader is this pudgy guy who attracted a mob on monsters to us by noisily digging up treasure, instead of doing what we were supposed to do.
+6Sb:
[Jayprocat]
*Sigh...*
Why wasn't Mudasamu in charge? With him as leader, I would've been home for dinner...
/KSb:
[Jayprocat]
Well...
It's true that we pretty much messed up our current mission to save anyone here seeking for treasure, since we need rescuing now as well.
/aSb:
[Jayprocat]
*Sniff*
Why did we have to be attacked by so many monsters on my first mission? I'm... I'm just a new recruit...
AKWb:
[Jayprocat]
No, I didn't just run away! The monsters were too stong and there were so many of them! Plus, it's our damn leader's fault.
AaWb:
[Jayprocat]
The monsters are all highly evolved turtles. And this island even looks like a turtle! But I guess you knew that already.
AqWb:
[Jayprocat]
I had no idea that this island's monsters were so much stronger than the ones that live near Alberta.
A6Wb:
[Jayprocat]
Their shells are so tough, and we can't seem to find any sort of weak point! I have no idea how to fight these turtles!
BKWb:
[Jayprocat]
You're so mean...
I mean, I'm really new at this!
BaWb:
[Squall]
Am I the only one left? Where are all my comrades?! I... I'm about to go crazy!
CKWb:
[Squall]
No, we would never run away from the face of danger.
CaWb:
[Squall]
Well, we sort of did, but that was because it was a direct order from our leader! If a knight is loyal and proud, he will accept his leader's orders without question!
CqWb:
[Squall]
Even if that leader is a little greedy, with hair that might be thinning...
C6Wb:
[Squall]
^FF0000And has the body
of a pregnant whale^000000.
DKWb:
[Squall]
Oh wait!
I shouldn't
have said that!
What I meant
to say was...
DaWb:
[Squall]
^CC0000And has the
body of a whale
pregnant with twins^000000.
DqWb:
[Squall]
Grrrr...!
I'm so angry!
Why can't Mudasamu
be our leader?!
D6Wb:
[Squall]
We had good plans for this mission, made by our second in command, Mudasamu. However, they were executely poorly by the first in command.
EKWb:
[Squall]
Whenever Takuyaka leads a mission, he always manages to mess it up! Why do the leaders in Alberta like him anyway?!
EaWb:
[Squall]
*Sniff*
I sweat and I bleed for the Alberta Security Knights, and still I'm tortured by the fact that Sir Porky commands us. I hate it!
EqWb:
[Squall]
Our weapon and armor budget is always gone after Takuyaka visits a buffet... Why do we have to be so miserable?!
E6Wb:
[Nysurea]
Hm? I'm surprised that someone around here is still alive.
FKWb:
[Nysurea]
I'm beginning to think all my comrades have been killed by the monsters here...
FqWb:
[Nysurea]
Even though you're pretty strong, sooner or later you might need a reprieve. I can send you back to Alberta right now if you want.
GaWb:
[Nysurea]
Okay then, let me activate this teleport thingee donated to us by Kafra Corporation...
GqWb:
[Nysurea]
Ah, that's the spirit! You should be careful though. And if you see any other of my comrades, let them know I'm here, would you?
HKWb:
[Nysurea]
You look lost! If you stick around here, well, the monsters will probably get the best of you sooner or later.
HaWb:
[Nyusurea]
Anyway...
Good luck!
You'll need it!
HqWb:
[Nysurea]
Huh...
You look calm and collected. If all our soldiers were as strong as you, we probably would not have been scattered.
H6Wb:
[Nysurea]
I have dreams of becoming a great knight, but since our 'leader' is all plump and no brains, we're stuck in this predicament.
IKWb:
[Nysurea]
Anyway, be careful in this third level of Turtle Island. A lot of our men were annihilated when they went to explore the East and North sides, so be careful!

Bleh. All that other food is
nothing compared to the 
hearty flavor of meat. Yeap,

[Rochito]

Komodoru meat all day when
you go BBQ camping. Komodoru
is an animal native to Comodo

What makes this meat even
more delicious is the special
Koserahserah seasoning they
use. That stuff is almost...
addictive. Without it, we
can't start our barbeque!
wDeg:
[Rochito]
If we settled on anything
less than the very best BBQ,
then our comrades that died
to help ^FF0000banish that witch^000000 would
surely be ashamed of us!
wTeg:

Say, would you do us a favor?
The Chief of Comodo was going
to bring the Koserahserah and
join us for our barbeque, but
we're guessing he's got to
cancel because of his duties.
wjeg:
[Rochito]
Let's see, our Chief lives to
the west of these campgrounds.
Would you visit him and see
what's taking him so long
to get over here?
wzeg:
[Rochito]
You know, people gather
on these campgrounds in
memory and respect of those
that have fallen in battle
against the witch of Comodo.
xDeg:
[Rochito]
Long before Comodo was
built inside this huge cave,
this witch used to live in here.^FFFFFF  ^000000 A lot of people died trying to
get rid of her, but there're^FFFFFF      ^000000 rumors that she's still around...
xTeg:
[Rochito]
Komodoru meat is especially
great when it's seasoned with
Koserahserah. That flavoring
is one of Comodo's claims to
fame! You should try some~
xjeg:
[Rochito]
Speaking of which, our Chief
still hasn't come and brought
the Koserahserah! Would you
see what's taking him so long?
His house is located west of
these campgrounds.
xzeg:
[Rochito]
Oh, hey, you're back.
Did you speak to our
Chief? Don't tell me
he had to cancel--we've
been planning this outing
with him for a quite a while...
yDeg:
^3355FFYou give Rochito the
Koserahserah seasoning,
and explain why the Chief
cannot attend the barbeque.^000000
yTeg:
[Rochito]
Awww, nuts. I guess he's
got responsbilities, but it's
still a little disappointing.
He's a buddy, after all. Well,
at least he was kind enough
to send the Koserahserah.
yjeg:
[Rochito]
It's really too bad that
he can't join us. Ah, I've got
an idea! Would you please bring
this bottle to Tausupa, er, our
Chief? It's Mureuchieligu, a
special vintage wine~
yzeg:
^3355FFYou've received a bottle
of Mureuchieligu wine to
deliver to the Comodo Chief.^000000
zDeg:
[Rochito]
I know that I should be
delivering that bottle of
wine to the Chief myself,
but I've got to tend to this
barbeque. I hope you 
understand...
zTeg:
[Rochito]
Anyway, you'd be doing
me a huge favor if you
spoke to the Chief, and gave
him my thanks, along with
that bottle of Mureuchieligu.
zjeg:
[Rochito]
Oh, hey there~
Thanks for helping us
out earlier. I wish the
Chief would join us in our
barbeque, but I understand
that he has to protect Comodo.
zzeg:
[Rochito]
Hey, you know what?
I can't exactly repay you
with, you know, actual stuff,
but I can give you a hot tip.
There's some guy at the local
Pub with some precious info.
0Deg:
[Rochito]
Yeah, supposedly, this
guy knows more about the
cave that Comodo was built
in... Anyway, I really get the
feeling that it just might
lead to something, you know?
0jeg:
[Rockha]
Oh man...
I'm so excited!
My buddies and I've
been planning to get
together for this barbeque
for such a long time~
1Deg:
[Rockha]
Yeah, some of us know
each other when we fought
together in the War of the
Witch. In fact, one of them
is the Chief of this village!
Huh, why isn't he here yet?
1Teg:
[Rockha]
Anyway, even though
our stations in life have
changed, thankfully we're
still friends. It's kinda weird, though, being on a first name
basis with a village chief.
1jeg:
[Rockha]
Makes me feel...
Important. I'm hobnobbing
with a major political figure,
after all. Amazing where your
friends can end up in life...
1zeg:
[Rockha]
I've almost forgotten
how much I love hanging
out with these guys. We
should have barbeques
together all the time~
2Deg:
[Rockha]
Wha--? Tausupa can't come,
but he still sent us all of this Koserahserah? What a guy...
I guess... That gives us
a reason to hold another
barbeque here soon, right?
2Teg:
[Rockha]
Hey, when you deliver
that wine to Tausupa, the
Village Chief, would you let
him know that we miss the guy?
He may be busy, but he'll always^FFFFFF  ^000000 be our irreplaceable buddy.
2jeg:
[Rockha]
Oh hey, you spoke
to Tausupa? Ah, it's
too bad that he's busy,
but it's great to hear that
he'll enjoy our gift. Okay~
I believe it's time to eat!
2zeg:
[Rockha]
But before that, let's
make a toast... to Tausupa!
Guardian of Comodo, and
one of the best friends that
a guy can have! Cheers!
Hahahaha hahahaha~!
3Deg:
[Rockha]
Ahh, you know what would
make this meal perfect?
Some of that legendary
^3355FFComodo Cheese^000000 that I heard
about from ^3355FFToruna^000000. Sure, it
might not exist, but still...!
3Teg:
[Rockha]
You know, you're a really
chill person. Thanks for
helping us keep in touch
with our old friend, the
Village Chief. Man, being
responsible must be rough...
3jeg:
[Rockha]
There's two things that
would make our barbeque
absolutely perfect--having
the Village Chief here, and
some of that legendary Comodo^FFFFFF     ^000000 Cheese that ^3355FFToruna^000000 told me about.
4Deg:
[Emralhandas]
Rockha, let me pour
you another drink. We
always dreamed of this
during the War of the Witch...
Having a good time, all of us
together in a time of peace~
4jeg:
[Emralhandas]
Before I tell you about the
War of the Witch, I guess
I should tell you about the
quest to retrieve 4 rare swords
of power, said to be the most
powerful weapons ever made.
4zeg:
[Emralhandas]
Now, all 4 swords were
successfully found 10 years
after the search began. Then,
4 protectors were chosen to
ensure that the swords did
not fall into the wrong hands.
5Deg:
[Emralhandas]
You might not think so just
by looking at us, but we were
the protectors--me, Rockha,
Rochito, and Tausupa, the chief
of this village. Now, we guarded these weapons very carefully...
5Teg:
[Emralhandas]
However, that didn't deter
Mariposum, ancient witch of
Comodo, from attacking us and
trying to steal the swords. She
was incredibly powerful, and
we needed an army to fight her.
5jeg:
[Emralhandas]
That was the War of the
Witch, basically. Mariposum
with her own strange weapon
of mass destruction against the
four of us backed by a large
force of courageous soldiers.
5zeg:
[Emralhandas]
Many of our comrades died...
But finally we succeeded in
imprisoning the witch by using
the power of the swords. Yeah,
if it weren't for Tausupa, we'd
never have been able to do it.
6Deg:
[Emralhandas]
Rockha, we still have
to finish our mission:
eat all of the barbeque
that that we possibly can!
Let's just stuff ourselves...
All the way until tommorrow!
6jeg:
[Rotute]
Years ago, there was a huge
quest to retrieve 4 rare swords
of incredible power, supposedly
the strongest swords ever made!
But you know, there's a strange
rumor about a secret 5th sword.
6zeg:
[Rotute]
This 5th sword is supposed
to be hidden near Glastheim.
If it does exist, it might have
the power to change the world!
Isn't that freakin' scary?
7Deg:
[Rotute]
Hey, isn't that Koserahserah?
That's the best seasoning that
you can have for meat dishes!
Oh, you got that from the Chief
to give to Rochito? Wow, they
must be really good friends...
7Teg:
[Rotute]
Hello, thanks for helping
out Rockha, Rochito and
Emralhandas. They've known
me since I was born, so it's
like they're family to me.
7jeg:
[Rotute]
One of the reasons that
they brought me here to
Comodo was so that I could
finally meet Tausupa. But...
I guess he's too busy now.
Still, I like this place!
8Deg:
[Rinta]
I didn't mean to,
but I accidentally
eavesdropped on those
people over there. Are
they really old friends
with our Village Chief?
8Teg:
[Rinta]
In that case, they must
be getting the special
treatment usually reserved
for visiting dignitaries and
the like. Or something like that. ^FFFFFF    ^000000
8zeg:
[Razy]
Those people over there
are friends of the Village
Chief? I was wondering about
them for the longest time...
I didn't even know our Chief
had friends outside of Comodo.
9Deg:
[Razy]
You know, they kind of
strike me as old war buddies,
sprinkling their conversations
with words like ''mission'' all
the time. Then, there's those
little scars they all have...
9jeg:
[BBQ Boy]
D-daddy! Is what those
people talking about true?
Was there really an evil
witch here in our village?
9zeg:
[BBQ Mama]
Honey...
I'm sure those
good people were
just kidding around~
How can that be true?
+Deg:
[BBQ Papa]
Now, now, don't tell
me my little man is afraid
of something like a little
witch. It's just an old fairy
tale, son: no reason to
feel frightened at all.
+Teg:
[BBQ Boy]
No, Daddy, I'm not
scared! But if the witch
really lived here, then her
home is somewhere around
here in Comodo, right? I'm
gonna go find it someday!
+jeg:
[BBQ Mama]
Oh, but I'm sure our
Chief would already know
something about that witch
if she truly exists. Anyway,
let's hurry and eat before
the barbeque burns, okay?
+zeg:
[BBQ Boy]
Yay, barbeque!
Mmmmm... Someday,
if that witch is real,
I'm gonna find out
all about her!
/jeg:
[Tausupa]
Maybe you can't tell because
of the way the light reflects,
but Comodo is actually built
inside a huge cave, giving the
illusion of an eternal night.
It's quite beautiful, really...
/zeg:
[Tausupa]
People come from all over
the world to experience the
excitement and beauty of
our unique little village.
We've become quite
the tourist attraction~
ADig:
[Tausupa]
Oh, how are my friends
doing? I really wish that
I could have delivered that
Koserahserah personally,
but I can't shirk my duties as
Village Chief and protector.
ATig:
^3355FFYou give Tausupa the
Meruchieligu wine that
Rochito asked you to deliver.^000000
Ajig:
[Tausupa]
Ah... How very kind of
them! They really sent me
this wine? I'm truly touched...
Rockha must have chosen
this--I'll be sure to enjoy it.
Azig:
[Tausupa]
Would you please express my
thanks to my friends, ^3355FFRochito^000000,
and ^3355FFRockha^000000? It's been far too
long since I've seen them, but
I hope that I get a chance to
visit them someday soon.
BDig:
[Tausupa]
Greetings, adventurer,
I am Tausupa, the Chief of
Comodo, a city famous for its^FFFFFF     ^000000 beauty and nightlife. I hope you
enjoy your stay, whether you are^FFFFFF  ^000000 seeking excitement or relaxation~
Bzig:
[Tausupa]
Ah yes, Comodo is world
famous for its Casino. There
are many games that you can
enjoy, but you'll need to use
the Casino's special Eulwo^FFFFFF        ^000000 currency and conversion system...
CDig:
[Tausupa]
Banished witch...?
Ah ha ha, do not worry,
my friend, that is merely
a very old tale. Not worth
your concern at all...
CTig:
[Tausupa]
Ah, judging from the scent
of BBQ meat on your clothes,
I'm guessing that you ran into
Rochito in the campgrounds, 
right? He must have told you^FFFFFF      ^000000 that old story about the witch...
Cjig:
[Tausupa]
I'd like nothing better
than to join them, but I must
stay here. The witch does exist, and one my jobs is to make sure
that she does not revive by using my sword's power to suppress her.
Czig:
[Tausupa]
Although I planned to see
them today, my duties must
take priority. Would you please
take this seasoning to Rochito
and let him know that I can't
come, and that I'm sorry...?
DDig:
^3355FFYou have received
the Koserahserah
seasoning from the Chief.^000000
DTig:
[Tausupa]
Thank you so much...
I understand that my
friends cannot begin the
barbeque without Comodo's
world famous seasoning...
Djig:
[Tausupa]
Please take this special
Koserserah seasoning to
my friend ^3355FFRochito^000000 at the
barbeque campground. Thanks
again for your help, adventurer. ^FFFFFF     ^000000
EDig:
[Martine]
Gambling...? The games
provided here in the Comodo
Casino are a higher form of
entertainment than gambling.
Do you know what I mean?
ETig:
[Martine]
Granted, I did lose
all of my zeny playing
in this Casino, but I have
no regrets. I'll simply earn
more money, then blow it all
again. Or I just might win big!
Ejig:
[Martine]
Bwahahahaahah~!
Yes, I can only lose so
many times until I hit the
jackpot! You see, you see?
I'm playing the freakin' odds.
FDig:
[Scoursege]
Damn it! Where did that
guy go? He promised me that
he'd easily double my money!
Wait. Oh, wait. Oh... Oh no...
FTig:
[Scoursege]
Don't tell me that I just got
conned out of my money!
Oh no! Still, I better report
this to the proper authorities,
no matter how ashamed I feel...
Fzig:
[Roberto]
Heh heh heh...
Whaaaat a gullible
guy. I took his money
so easily! I mean, I didn't
even come up with that great
of a lie, and he gave it to me!
GTig:
[Deniroz]
All I need is for this
little steel bead to fall
into the right hole. Then,
I'll win the jackpot. Alright.
Here goes. One last time...
Gjig:
[Deniroz]
No! No, I was so close!
Alright, next time I should
be even closer, right? Yeah.
Okay, this time will be the
last time. Not again! Alright,
j-just one more t-time...
HDig:
[Shalone]
Oh, I'm sorry, sir,
but it looks like you
lost again. Maybe you
should quit for now...
You've been having quite
a run of really bad luck...
Hjig:
[Stonae]
N-no...
I lost again?!
But I can't quit like
this! I'm gonna keep
going, and I'm gonna
leave this place a winner!
IDig:
[G . J]
The more I think about it,
it seems easier to become
rich by working, saving, and
making wise investments than
to, you know... Rely on some
kind of huge jackpot prize.
ITig:
[G . J]
Gambling seems fun, but
it seems smarter to make
money in other ways. Sure,
working hard is no fun, but
there are ways to use your^FFFFFF        ^000000 money to make more of it, right?
Ijig:
[G . J]
There's also the matter of
being smart and responsible
about your money--I mean, you're more likely to blow all your cash
if you win it, right? Yeah, you
gotta be wise about it all...
JDig:
[Loyar]
Comodo Casino's interior
design is so pleasing to the
eyes, so clean and simple.
The atmosphere here is perfect,
and it makes me want to play 
some more. Alright, let's go!
JTig:
[Loyar]
Hmm... Maybe I better
go home soon. I didn't
spend all the money that
I set aside for gambling
quite yet, but it's not a good
idea to stay out too long.
Jjig:
[Loyar]
I have to admit, the
atmosphere of this place
is exciting and addictive.
Even when you're tired, the
energy of this place just
gets into you, you know?
Jzig:
[Loyar]
Although this kind of place
may encourage people with
serious gambling problems,
it's much nicer to gamble
here than in a place that's
dirtier and more questionable.
KDig:
[Loyar]
Whoa whoa whoa...
Why did that guy make
that bet? What an amateur...
Er, I guess you don't know
too much about this game.
As for me, I'm just a fan~
KTig:
[Loyar]
I'm a big fan of a lot
of these games, but I'll
admit that I'm an even bigger
fan of winning! Still, I have
enough sense to stay out of
those high stakes games.
Kzig:
[Moo]
Those cheating punks!
They'll never show their
faces here again: otherwise
they're gonna hafta get new
ones! Oh--Sorry, I didn't
see you there~ Hahahaha~
LDig:
[Moo]
Greetings, I am Moo,
manager of the Comodo
Casino. We pride ourselves in
serving all of our customers'
needs, doing all we can so that^FFFFFF   ^000000 your visit here is unforgettable.
LTig:
[Moo]
All of our guests can enjoy
our general gaming area, and
we also provide a VIP area
where high rollers can play
exciting high stakes games.
Ljig:
[Moo]
We always welcome all of
your suggestions, and are
always seeking to improve
your experience here in
the Comodo Casino.
MDig:
[Zyosegirl]
People call me the
Sea Lady because I'm
always here working,
gathering clams and other
sea creatures to sell. It's
a pretty good living, actually.
MTig:
[Zyosegirl]
It's nice to be able to work
outdoors, but someday, I want
to save enough money and move
to the city. I'm still young, you^FFFFFF ^000000 know, and I've got dreams
that I want to fulfill~
Mzig:
[Ziyaol]
Ahhh, it's nice being
a fisherman. You just
relax and let the fish
come to you. Well, it takes
some skill to catch as much
fish as I do with no effort~
NDig:
[Ziyaol]
I like the leisure involved
in my job, but if it's not one
thing, it's another. Yeah, that
daughter of mine over there
won't stop harping about 
moving to the biiig city.
NTig:
[Ziyaol]
Why does she want to leave
me so badly?! But if I don't
let her go, she'll run away.
What am I going to do with
that girl? Well, I can't really
stop her from dreaming...
Nzig:
[Daeguro]
I love playing in
the sand-- it's so soft
and clean and pretty!
But when I grow up,
I wanna go to Alberta
and see everything I can!
OTig:
[Serutero]
Hello, I'm Serutero,
guardian of the roads that
lead to Sandaruman Fortress.
If you really want to go there,
I'll permit you to continue, but^FFFFFF  ^000000 you must beware of its dangers...
PDig:
[Serutero]
So you're really going
to go to Sandaruman
Fortress. Alright then,
good luck, and be careful!
PTig:
[Serutero]
Although Sandaruman
Fortress is infested with
monsters now, it used to be
a province where people lived.
However, they were always
invaded and pillaged...
Pjig:
[Serutero]
Sandaruman's inhabitants
eventually adapted to the
invasions, developing smoke
signals and fortifications to
withstand the ravages of war.
Then, Comodo was built...
Pzig:
[Serutero]
Comodo grew in power and
influence and eventually annexed Sandaruman. More and more people
moved from the fortress to Comodo until Sandaruman Fotress was
essentially abandoned.
QDig:
[Serutero]
There were a few people
remaining in Sandaruman,
but they revolted and some
fledging government came into
power there. The monsters took
the chance to take over...
QTig:
[Serutero]
There's nothing around
Sandaruman now. Well, nothing
except maybe Paros Lighthouse,
which is southwest of here. That place might be of interest to
aspiring Rogues, I hear...
Qjig:
[Serutero]
You know, if you're
tired of traveling, you
can rest in ^3355FFComodo^000000. That
place is a pretty popular
tourist attraction, especially
for you adventurer types.
RDig:
[Rahasu]
Hey, I'm Rahasu.
If you want to learn
a little more about
Paros Lighthouse, I'll
be happy to tell you.
Rjig:
[Rahasu]
For many years, this
lighthouse guided many
ships to shore. That was
a long time ago: now this
lighthouse sits quietly,
unused, but never unloved.
Rzig:
[Rahasu]
Although this place
isn't the center of
trade and commerce that
it used to be, plenty of
people still wander to this
area. I wonder why, exactly...
SDig:
[Rahasu]
Hey, before you leave,
you really ought to check
the view from the lighthouse.
It's... It's breathtaking...
Sjig:
[Hallosu]
Hello, this is one of the
lighthouses that make up
Paros Lighthouse. However,
right now it's undergoing
renovation, so it's not
open to the public.
TDig:
[Zain]
Would you like to
board a ship on the
Reudelus route? You
can travel on Reudelus
to Alberta or Izlude.
Tzig:
[Zain]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
zeny for the boarding fare.
UDig:
[Zain]
Travel by ship is
still one of the safest and
dependable methods of
transportation. I invite you
to try Reudelus travel soon~
Ujig:
[Sarumane]
Would you like to
board a ship on the
Reudelus route? You
can travel on Reudelus
to Alberta or Izlude.
Uzig:
[Sarumane]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
zeny for the boarding fare.
VDig:
[Sarumane]
Travel by ship is
still one of the safest and
dependable methods of
transportation. I invite you
to try Reudelus travel soon~
Vjig:
[Toruna]
When I think about it,
there are many fascinating
facts about Comodo. Can
you believe this entire city
is built inside a natural cave?
WTig:
[Toruna]
Oh, this is a huge cave,
but it's not impossible for
nature to create something
of this size and scale if given
thousands, maybe even millions
of years. Let me explain...
Wjig:
[Toruna]
Now, water is known as
a universal solvent: running
water will carve its own path
in rock, given enough time.
Now, keep in mind that this
cave was once solid limestone.
Wzig:
[Toruna]
Years and years of running
water from the rains and the
water table have broken down
this giant pocket of limestone,
clearing out this huge, open
area, the Comodo Cave.
XDig:
[Toruna]
That may sound incredulous,
but cracks in limestone grow
into faults, then spacious gaps
over years and years of erosion. Now, isn't natural science just
amazing? You've got to agree...
XTig:
[Toruna]
Yes, that is rather
peculiar. What's also
strange is this rumor I've
been hearing about. Now, are^FFFFFF      ^000000 you familiar with Comodo Cheese?
Xjig:
[Toruna]
It's this urban legend
about this magnificent cheese
that you can only find in Comodo. Now, not too many people believe
it. I mean, you need goats or cows
in order to make any cheese.
Xzig:
[Toruna]
However, there's this
strange man that insists
on its existence. The locals
here chalk him up to be some
sort of common loon, but who
knows? Maybe it does exist...
YDig:
[Toruna]
Well, you can decide for
yourself whether he's off
his rocker. The last time
I saw him, he was in the
Comodo Bar, so you can
probably find him there.
YTig:
[Toruna]
Well, I like to think of
Comodo as unique. What's
really strange are some of
the locals in this area. I've
already told you about the
man in the Comodo Bar, yes?
Yjig:
[Toruna]
He keeps insisting
that there is a special
kind of cheese in Comodo
that you cannot get anywhere
else. It sounds crazy, but his
claim may be worth verifying...
Yzig:
[Toruna]
Ah, did you know that
before it was an exotic
village of excitement and
leisure, Comodo was once
a haven for evil creatures, ruled^FFFFFF ^000000 by a witch named Meropusum?
ZDig:
[Toruna]
This witch lay dormant for
years until she was awoken
somehow years ago. She was
a huge threat to the people, but then she was finally defeated
in the famous War of the Witch.
ZTig:
[Toruna]
One of the heroes of that
war became the current Chief
of this village, and it was
through his leadership that
Comodo grew into a thriving
tourist attraction.
Zjig:
[Toruna]
However, the threat of
Meropusum still exists,
so I would be careful when
exploring the uninhabited
areas of the Comodo region.
Zzig:
[Toruna]
There's much to do
in this city of Comodo,
as well as much to learn
about it. I can never tire of
visiting this exotic city...
aTig:
[Rakusa]
See that guy sitting
over there? All he does
is talk about Comodo Cheese,
just mumbling nonsense about
its incredible flavors all day
long. He's nuts, I tell you.
ajig:
[Rakusa]
First of all, you need
freakin' milk to make any
cheese. You see any cows
around here? Nope, I thought
so! Still, I think he really
believes that it exists...
azig:
[Rakusa]
Damn it! I know for a fact
that the idea of Comodo even
having a cheese is crazy, but
that guy's talking has gotten
me curious now! Maybe it does
exist? How would it even taste?
bDig:
[Rakusa]
You know, Comodo has
a reputation for offering
high class recreation, so
people forget that we actually
have two dangerous dungeons.
bTig:
[Rakusa]
You adventurers need to
be extra careful if you explore
the caves--the monsters there
are unusually strong. Make
sure that you're well prepared
before you even think of going!
bzig:
[Kichiri]
Freakin' ^3355FFMagatu^000000...!
Can he talk about anything else
aside from Comodo Cheese?
I don't see why he's so excited
about the stuff! Everyone knows
it's just an old wive's tale.
cDig:
[Kichiri]
Would you do
me a favor and get
Magatu to shut up?
I just want to drink
my alcohol in peace!
cTig:
[Kichiri]
Cripes! Now Magatu's
got me wondering! I mean,
just because I've never seen
Comodo Cheese doesn't mean
it doesn't exist, right? Curses!^FFFFFF  ^000000 Now I'm thinking about it too!
cjig:
[Kichiri]
There's more to do than
gambling in Comodo, you
know. Sometimes, I love
to watch the Dancers on
stage in the middle of the
village. They're so glamorous~
czig:
[Kichiri]
I hear that the Dance
Academy only accepts female
Archers to become prospective
Dancers. I guess that makes
sense--they're tone and fit,
but not musclebound either...
dTig:
[Magatu]
Comodo Cheese...
It really exists...!
And I'm so close to
having the proof! Oh...
That look in your eyes...
Y-you really believe me!
djig:
[Magatu]
At long last, not only
someone who believes me,
but an adventurer to boot!
Great, this is perfect! Now,
listen, you want to learn more
about Comodo Cheese, right?
dzig:
[Magatu]
Well, I happen to know
someone who knows someone
that might be able to give you
the chance to try it for yourself! His name is ^3355FFManzi^000000	, and you can
find him in Comodo's Casino.
eDig:
[Magatu]
Oh, here, before I forget,
take my lucky bottle cap!
Show this to Manzi, and he'll
know that I sent you, and that
you want to learn more about
the elusive Comodo Cheese.
eTig:
^3355FFYou have received
Magatu's lucky bottle
cap to present to Manzi.
ejig:
[Magatu]
Oh, don't forget to
show my lucky bottle cap
to Manzi, okay? You can find
him inside Comodo's Casino~
Good luck, and I hope you get
to try that Comodo Cheese~
ezig:
[Magatu]
It's true, it really
exists... Comodo Cheese!
Its flavor must be incomparably
delicious if adventurers have
quested to obtain it for so
many generations...
fTig:
[{}]
Excuse, but I'm
looking for someone
named Manzi. Do you
know where I can find him?
fjig:
[Manzi]
Hey guy, I'm right here.
So what exactly do you
want? I'm, um, not in
trouble or anything, am I?
fzig:
^3355FFYou give Manzi the
lucky bottle cap that you
received from Magatsu.^000000
gDig:
[Manzi]
Whoa, Magatsu gave you
this? Ah, okay, so you must
be looking for that Comodo
Cheese he keeps talking about.
Alright, I owe him a favor, so
I'll tell you who to talk to...
gTig:
[Manzi]
From the Casino, go north
towards the center of the
village, and then look to
the right where you'll see
the Dance Stage. You'll see
this old woman right there.
gjig:
[Manzi]
Don't be fooled by the
way she looks--that old
lady is one of Comodo's
wisest elders. Ask her
about the cheese, and
let her know I sent you~
gzig:
[Manzi]
Ah, she won't take you
very seriously unless you
show her this. Magatsu gave
you his lucky bottle cap, so I'm^FFFFFF  ^000000 gonna give you my lucky coin!
The old crone'll recognize it~
hDig:
^3355FFYou received Manzi's
''lucky coin.'' Strangely
enough, both sides
are heads.
hTig:
[Manzi]
Look for the old crone
near the Dance Stage here
in Comodo and ask her about
Comodo Cheese, alright? Ah,
and try not to insult her, kay?
It'll make me look bad~
hjig:
[Manzi]
What th...?
What's a kid like
you doing in a Casino?
Sure, it's not against the
rules, but I think you oughta
scram and play somewhere else!
hzig:
[Manzi]
Hey, have a good time in
the Casino, but don't go buck
wild. You wanna walk out of
here with the shirt on your back,^FFFFFF ^000000 you know? Some people don't
even leave here with that...
iTig:
[Hullaris]
Hula~hula~hula~
Love togther, love together,
we've groovin' on some more~
Love togther, love together,
we've living on the floor~
jDig:
^3355FFYou present Muzi's lucky
coin to the old woman.^000000
jTig:
[Hullaris]
Love! Love!
Love together~
Love! Love!
Love togeth-hm?
Oh, that's um, Muzi's
cheat coin, isn't it?
jjig:
[Hullaris]
He always said that he
might send someone with
that coin to me as a sign
of his trust in that person.
I suppose, then, that I'm
at your service. Now...
jzig:
[Hullaris]
What exactly did you need?
I'm guessing you've come
here to ask me something
about Comodo. As one of the
oldest elders, I know more
about this village than most...
kDig:
[{}]
Actually, I was hoping
you can tell me about
Comodo Cheese. If it really
exists, I'd like to know
where I can get some.
kTig:
[Hullaris]
Oh... That. First of all,
Comodo Cheese does exist,
and it's as precious as the
legends say. However, it's
not a true cheese, although^FFFFFF       ^000000 you may think so from its taste.
kjig:
[Hullaris]
Yes, it's a very rare, natural
substance and isn't made from
cow or goat milk or anything
like that. However, Comodo
Cheese isn't merely food.
No, it's much more...
kzig:
[Hullaris]
Those that eat Comodo
Cheese find that their
true potential is unlocked.
Comodo Cheese's true name
is the ^3355FFAwakening Stone^000000. Now,
doesn't that sound impressive?
lDig:
[Hullaris]
The Awakening Stone is
one of the keys to obtaining
some kind of forbidden power.
That's why only the bravest
adventurers can expect the
chance of ever eating it.
lTig:
[Hullaris]
Do you really wish to
eat the Comodo Cheese and
see where its power may lead
you? If so, you'll have to endure great challenges to obtain it...
ljig:
[Hullaris]
When you've decided
to pursue the Awakening
Stone, seek out a man named
^3355FFNigirboran^000000. He will judge
whether you are worthy
of the Comodo Cheese...
lzig:
[Hullaris]
Now, you should be
able to find Nigiroban
training somewhere in one
of Comodo's Dungeon Caves.
I'll send him a message to
let him know you're coming...
mDig:
[Hullaris]
Love! Love!
Love together~
Love! Love!
Love togeth-hm?
Girl, you're ruining
my groove! Get away~
mTig:
[Hullaris]
Love! Love!
Love together~
Love! Love!
Love togeth-hm?
Boy, you're ruining
my groove! Now beat it!
mjig:
[Hullaris]
Hmm? So you've failed
Nigirboran's test, have
you? Well, you better train
until you can pass it. Otherwise, eating Comodo Cheese could
mean your death, you know.
mzig:
[Hullaris]
Ah, you've returned.
So were you able to pass
Nigirboran's little test? An
adventurer like you should
be able to have no problem
with it. I've got faith in you~
nDig:
^3355FFYou present the token that
signifies that you passed
Nigirboran's test to Hullaris.^000000
nTig:
[Hullaris]
Ah, I was right after all.
I'm glad to see that you've
proven worthy of eating this
Comodo Cheese, or more
accurately, the Awakening
Stone. Here, let me get it...
njig:
[Hullaris]
There you are...
Only brave and worthy
adventurers are allowed to
eat this. Understand that
eating Comodo Cheese is
a rare and coveted honor!
nzig:
^3355FFHullaris carefully
hands you a plate of
Comodo Cheese. You enjoy
the rich, smooth flavor of
each and every morsel...
It's sublimely delicious!^000000
oDig:
^3355FFAfter you finish eating the
Comodo Cheese, you feel
a subtle, yet definite energy
gently pulsing through your
body. You feel a powerful, yet
quiet confidence of being able
to accomplish anything.^000000
oTig:
[Hullaris]
Hahahah! So what
do you think? It's great,
isn't it? It's unreal, how
delicious it is. All other
foods can never match the
quality of Comodo Cheese~
ojig:
[Hullaris]
Now, I know that you probably
have things to do, but might
I suggest that you visit the
town of Al De Baran? There's
a man there that can tell you
about the Slate of Muriniel.
ozig:
[Hullaris]
You've already eaten the
Awakening Stone, so you may
as well obtain the other things
that you need to earn one of
the three forbidden swords.
It's just a thought...
pDig:
[Hullaris]
Ah... Dance.
It's more than just a form
of entertainment. It's art,
it's seduction, it's battle,
and it's love. Only a true
Dancer can understand this...
pTig:
[Hullaris]
You know, Comodo is famous
for its Dance Academy and the
Dancers that have been trained
there. If you know any female
Archers, why don't you suggest
visiting the school to them?
pzig:
[Nigirboran]
You're the one that
Hullaris sent? So you're
here to earn the right to
eat the Awakening Stone...
Or Comodo Cheese, as it's
more commonly known.
qDig:
[Nigirboran]
Yes, it has many names...
But it's more than a mere
tasty treat--the Awakening
Stone can help you access
your true potential. But if you're not prepared... then you'll die.
qTig:
[Nigirboran]
If your mind and body
aren't sufficiently trained,
your body will reject the
Comodo Cheese and you
would die a slow, painful,
yet incredibly flavorful death.
qjig:
[Nigirboran]
But I'm sure that won't
happen to you! If Hullaris
sent you to me, you must
have a fighting chance, right?
So come back when you're
ready for the testing~
qzig:
[Nigirboran]
Good, you have returned--
I'd expect nothing less of
a brave and daring adventurer.
Now hold still as I gauge your
body's internal energies and see^FFFFFF  ^000000 if it can handle Comodo Cheese...
rDig:
[Nigirboran]
Alright.
Are you ready?
Now... Brace yourself!
Heeeeeyah! Hoooo-HAH!
rTig:
^3355FFA powerful current of
warmth immediately coarses
through your body from head
to toe, and you struggle to
keep yourself from writhing.^000000
rjig:
[Nigirboran]
Hmm... Your body seems
well trained, but your mind
is still reeling from the test.
If you ate the Comodo Cheese
now, you'd be reduced to an
incoherent invalid...
rzig:
[Nigirboran]
Go and train yourself
a little more, and try

4Q20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
I'm here to help you use
Turbo Track.
How may I help you today?
5g20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
The game rules are simple:
just get past obstacles
and reach the goal point as quickly as you can.
5w20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
Of course, various unexpected situations can occur,
depending on the people
you play with,
so I can't tell you
exactly what will happen.
6A20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
Knights, Lord Knights, Crusaders,
and Paladins that ride Peco Pecos
must leave their Peco Pecos
outside the stadium.
They can pick them up
after the match.
6Q20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
Whoever reaches the goal point first
wins the game, and
everyone else in the game
will be automatically moved back to the Lobby
as the game ends.
6g20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
If no one reaches the goal point
within the time limit,
then the game will end without a winner.
Please understand that this is necessary
to ensure smooth game flow.
6w20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
There's no job
or Level limit.
But there's
an admission fee
of 1,000 Zeny.
7A20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
This concludes
my game rules explanation.
Is there anything else you'd like to know?
7Q20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
Let me tell you about the courses.
First, let's check
the overall structure of the Turbo Track.
7g20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
Turbo Tracks
consist of ^4D4DFFsingle log bridges, mounds of boxes,
Cursed and Confusing deserts, flasher mazes,
single-path snails, snake dice paths,
small caves, invisible mazes,
just to name a few.
7w20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
The overall structure may vary,
depending on the mode, but basically,
each course
consists of 6 tracks,
excluding the start and goal points.
Would you like a more detailed explanation?
8Q20: Cursed and Confusing Desert and Flasher Maze
8w20: Snake Dice Path and Small Cave
9Q20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
The Single-log Bridge is the very first track
that you see when you start, and it's literally
a bridge made of a single log. If you fall from the log,
you'll have to start over again.
You have to be fast, but careful
when you cross it.
9g20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
The Box Hill is literally
a mound of boxes.
You'll have to move through the boxes
to reach the next track.
It shouldn't be too difficult, though.
9w20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
The Cursed and Confusing Desert
is a short desert track.
It doesn't take long to pass,
but it's unpredictable
since it's filled with
Cursed and Confusing effects.
+A20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
The Flasher Maze is a maze
riddled with traps.
No one knows what kinds of traps lie in wait
in that muddy swamp.
+Q20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
The Single-path Snail is a narrow path
that coils like
a snail shell.
Since it's mostly clear of obstacles,
you can focus on running.
You may feel dizzy if you run too fast, though.
+g20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
The Invisible Maze
is a wide, open room.
As you run toward the exit,
invisible walls will appear to block you.
Follow the hints you're given during the game
to go around them.
This is literally an invisible maze.
+w20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
The Snake Dice Path is a path
that as curvy as a slithering snake.
What about the dice?
That's because this path
hides good luck, just like the dice do.
If you're curious, you can see it for yourself.
/A20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
The Small Cave is a replica
of the cave dungeon somewhere in Payon.
There, you'll feel as if you're
exploring that dungeon.
/Q20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
Thank you for listening to
my course explanations.
/g20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
Is there anything else
you want to know?
/w20:
[Turbo Track Guide]
Let me tell you
about the game modes.
There are three different modes:
Normal, Expert,
and Single Challenge.

In any mode you choose,
you can use most of your skills.
Unlike Normal mode, ^4D4DFFExpert mode
lets you attack the other players^000000,
which makes it perfect for

AQ60:

Also, the ^4D4DFF16-player
course for each mode additionally features
the Invisible Maze^000000.

or 8-player course.
Ag60:

Single Challenge mode
encompasses all the available tracks,
and the name of the fastest player
will be recorded.
How would you like to take up the challenge?
Aw60:
[Turbo Track Guide]
Was that enough explanation?
Enjoy your time at the Turbo Track.

hDW9:
[Cenia]
The Monster Museum was founded by
the Sages of the Schweicherbil
Magic Academy after researching
every creature dwelling in the
Rune-Midgard continent.
hTW9:
[Cenia]
In this museum, you can see every
single monster in Rune-Midgard,
even the ones you hardly ever encounter.
hjW9:
[Cenia]
The glass tubes holding monsters
was developed with the latest
technology as a part of the
Schwartz Project. Rest assured,
you'll be well protected.
hzW9:
[Cenia]
Please check on the Opaque option
on your option windows by
pressing ALT + O, if you want to
see the monsters better.
iDW9:
[Cenia]
Feel free to talk to me anytime.
ijW9:
Scientific name : Deviace
Size : Medium
Attribute : Water
izW9:
Explanation :
This monster dwells under the deep
sea and has a round body with a
acetabulum on its dorsal side.
Although its sharp teeth are
intimidating, it has a very mellow
character.
jDW9:
Therefore, it never initiates
attack on an undersea traveller
unless it's attacked first.
However, once it becomes upset, it
uses high level magic skills. So
it's better to be careful with this monster.
jjW9:
Scientific name : Seal
Size : Medium
Attribute : Water
jzW9:
Explanation :
When you take a look at this
monster carefully, you will find
that it's not actually a seal but
an unidentified monster hiding
inside the seal-like leather
clothing.
kDW9:
It is rumored that the monster
wears this clothing in order
to protect its sensitive skin
from the weather. The Seal's
clothing is a very good material
for people to produce winter coats.
kjW9:
Scientific name : Sage Worm
Size : Small
Attribute : Neutral
kzW9:
Explanation :
A strange beast with the head of
an old scholar and the tail of a
worm. Although it is physically
weak, it has the intelligence
to support its comrades with
magic skills.
lDW9:
As its scholarly appearance
indicates, it's usually seen near books or book shelves.
ljW9:
Scientific name : Penomena
Size : Medium
Attribute : Poison
lzW9:
Explanation :
This monster dwells inside the
deepest part of caves where there
is enough moisture to keep it from
getting dried up.
mDW9:
Unlike Hydra, a similar looking
creature, it can move itself
towards its enemy using many
small appendixes on its acetabulum.
mTW9:
The long, thin tentacles on the
body shoot deadly poison which is
enough to kill its enemy at once.
mzW9:
Scientific name : Galapago
Size : Small
Attribute : Earth
nDW9:
Explanation :
It's a kind of bird, but sadly, its body is too heavy to fly.
It's very sensitive to sunlight so it carries a water bottle and wears sunglasses all the time.
nTW9:
Although gluttonous, it will
always cooperate to attack
prey, as well as predators.
Otherwise, Galapago is a
generally laid back monster.
nzW9:
Scientific name : Raydric
Size : Large
Attribute : Shadow
oDW9:
Explanation :
A suit of armor animated by the
spirit of a castle guard. The
spirit is bound to this armor by
a powerful curse.
oTW9:
Since Raydric used to be a castle
guard, it possesses fast movements
and powerful attack strength.
ozW9:
Scientific name : Chepet
  Size : Medium
  Attribute : Fire
pDW9:
Explanation :
An evil creature hiding in a
pretty doll. It attacks passersby
by striking matchsticks held in
the doll's hand. A very rare
monster since it dwells in
only a few places.
pjW9:
Scientific name : Violy
  Size : Medium
  Attribute : Neutral
pzW9:
Explanation :
A pretty doll looking creature with beautiful golden hair.
Since It plays violin all the time with a peaceful look on its face, people don't realize at first that it's a monster.
qDW9: Exercise extreme caution upon encountering a Violy. Otherwise, it will snatch your soul in no time with its charming song.
qjW9:
Scientific name : Alice 
  Size : Medium
  Attribute : Neutral
qzW9:
Explanation :
Alice is a robot made to assist as
a castle housemaid. They've been
known to remain and automatically
do their tasks long after the
castle has been abandoned.
rDW9:
Without any discernable power
source, how it moves and operates
is still a scientific mystery.
rjW9:
Scientific name : Assulter
  Size : Medium
  Attribute : Wind
rzW9:
Explanation :
Unlike other turtles on on Turtle
Island, this turtle stands on two
legs and attacks passersby with
the other two legs, wielding a
big shuriken from its back.
sDW9:
Interestingly, it creates a clone
to do more damage when it
encounters dangerous enemies.
It does very powerful damage using
its shuriken, but its nail attack
is more threatening.
tTW9:
Scientific name : Wanderer
  Size : Medium
  Attribute : Wind
tjW9:
Explanation :
Undead warrior who came back to
life through a curse. Considering
its technical fencing skill, he
must have been a very honorable
warrior as a living human.
tzW9:
Wanderer can move amazingly fast
and can slay enemies with a single
stroke of its sword.
uTW9:
Scientific name : Caterpillar
  Size : Small
  Attribute : Earth
ujW9:
Explanation :
Although the eyes of this creature
have atrophied due to living under
the earth, it uses a feeler and
appendices on its body to sense
objects in its dark surroundings.
uzW9:
Caterpillar is rumored to be the
larva of Creamy Fear, the advanced
Creamy.
vTW9:
Scientific name : Thief Bug
  ^FFFFFFScientific name :^000000 (Male)
  Size : Medium
  Attribute : Shadow
vjW9:
Explanation :
Although it has a big blue body,
it's also fast and voracious, just like other Thief Bugs.
vzW9: However, it is stronger than other Thief Bugs because it's designated to protect the females and babies from danger.
wTW9:
Scientific name : Tri Joint
  Size : Small
  Attribute : Earth
wjW9:
Explanation :
Tri Joint is a prehistoric
monster that is covered with
a hard shell, and uses a feeler
instead of eyes so that it can
live in dark places.
wzW9: Recently, since many Tri Joints have been discovered inside many caves, Sages are very excited to study them to learn more about the evolution of monsters in Rune-Midgard.
xTW9:
Scientific name : Arclouz
  Size : Medium
  Attribute : Earth
xjW9:
Explanation :
Hard shelled monster that coils
its body to attack its enemy.
Arclouz tend to stay in groups
and are very aggressive
creatures.
xzW9:
They have incredibly fast
movement speed, contrary to
their looks, and are often
compared to PecoPecos.
yTW9:
Scientific name : Dragon Tail
  Size : Medium
  Attribute : Wind
yjW9:
Explanation :
An insect which is considered as
a Libelluidae, or Dragon Fly. It
uses its strong tail to suck the
blood out of an enemy, or to put
the enemy to sleep by shooting
a sleeping poison.
zDW9:
Scientific name : Owl Duke
  Size : Large
  Attribute : Neutral
zTW9:
Explanation:
An owl that wears a count costume.
It's very intimidating looking
with its dark, yet suave look.
Owl Duke is not actually an owl,
but a devil with very sharp claws
on its big feet.
zjW9:
It's skillful at using many
lightning magic spells. When
you see it attacking an enemy,
you can sense the Owl Duke's
aristocratic pompousness.
0DW9:
Scientific name : Marine Sphere
  Size : Small
  Attribute : Water
0TW9:
Explanation :
A strange creature that wanders
in the deep oceans. It explodes
with great power when it's
touched, earning it the name
'The Sea Bomb.'
0jW9:
If there is a Marine Sphere
caught in the explosion of
another, a trigger explosion
will result, and can lead to
a dangerous chain reaction.
1DW9:
Scientific name : Mandragora
  Size : Medium
  Attribute : Earth
1TW9:
Explanation :
An insectivore that swallows
anything alive. When it finds
its prey, it strikes it first
with a long tentacle to
to paralyze it.
1jW9:
Once paralyzed, its prey is
put in a large tube attached
to its body where it is slowly
digested. Although this tube
has a skull mark, Mandragora
does not actually contain any
poison.
1zW9:
This digestive tube
apparatus also has a very unique,
but disgusting smell that is far
from useful in attracting prey.
2TW9:
Scientific name : Geographer
  Size : Medium
  Attribute : Earth
2jW9:
Explanation :
An insectivore that looks like
a sunflower. It uses the petal
like tentacles around its
mouth to attract and snare
its prey.
2zW9:
Unlike Mandragora, Geographer
does not have a tube to
store its prey. So it slowly
eats it's prey, little by little.
3DW9:
Although Geographer has small
and short roots, the roots are
tough and strong enough to
bear the weight of the upper body.
3TW9:
The namesake of this monster, a
human geographer that was
promptly eaten upon discovering
this species of beast, will
never be forgotten...
3zW9:
Scientific name : Rafflesia
  Size : Small
  Attribute : Earth
4DW9:
Explanation :
A puffy, leafy monster
threatened with extinction.
Rafflesia is the rarest
monster in Rune-Midgard and
is thus protected by law.
4TW9:
Due to this situation, most Sages
are having a hard time to
research this monster.
However, a few Sages are
currently seeking methods to
cultivate and save the Rafflesias.
4zW9:
Scientific name : Stem Worm
  Size : Medium
  Attribute : Wind
5DW9:
Explanation :
A mutated Worm Tail that has a
round, brownish grey body with
a small head. It is covered
with scales and has a long
stem-like tail which is used
as a whip in attacks.
5jW9:
Scientific name : Blazzer
  Size : Medium
  Attribute : Fire
5zW9:
Explanation :
This is a fire ball that has been
seen near volcanic zones.
Because of this monster's sudden
appearance, Sages believe that
volcanic activity may occur
sooner or later near Juno.
6DW9:
Blazzer blows out noxious gas
which harm passersby. It is
unknown whether or not these
are attacks or the Blazzer's
form of communication.
6jW9:
Scientific name : Ride Word
  Size : Small
  Attribute : Neutral
6zW9:
Explanation :
It's a cursed magic book with
sharp teeth. It exists to attack any living thing nearby.
7TW9:
Scientific name : Megalodon
  Size : Medium
  Attribute : Undead
7jW9:
Explanation :
A skeleton fish that was brought
back to life by a curse. Although
It looks very threatening, it's
benign and will not attack
undersea travellers outright.
8DW9:
Scientific name : Sleeper
  Size : Medium
  Attribute : Earth
8TW9:
Explanation :
Unidentified sand creature.
Usually it stays under the earth,
but when travellers step on the
sand, it may abruptly
appear to attack them.
8jW9:
It's smaller than Sandman and can
cause indirect attacks by causing a sand storm.
9DW9:
Scientific name : Ancient Mummy
  Size : Medium
  Attribute : Undead
9TW9:
Explanation :
A mummy cursed with eternal life.
Although wrapped in decaying
bandages, Ancient Mummy also
wears a splendid hair ornament
adorned with a snake.
9jW9:
This kind of head ornament
indicates that the Ancient
Mummy was a person of high rank
while he was still alive.
9zW9:
Since Ancient Mummy has
been wandering the underworld
for a long time, it does not have
any consciousness and will
attack any living thing nearby.
+TW9:
Scientific name : Incubus
  Size : Medium
  Attribute : Shadow
+jW9:
Explanation :
This demon attracts humans
with its stunningly beautiful
appearance. When it poses as a
male human, we call it Incubus.
As a female, we call it Succubus.
+zW9:
This devil targets people with
mental vulnerabilities so that
it can eventually take them to hell.
/TW9:
Scientific name : Succubus
  Size : Medium
  Attribute : Shadow
/jW9:
Explanation :
This demon attracts humans
with its stunningly beautiful
appearance. When it poses as a
female human, we call it Succubus.
As a male, we call it Incubus.

x0LA:

yELA:

adventurer. I hope

yULA:
[Cavitar]

ykLA:

y0LA:

10 Emveretarcon,
3 Coal and

zELA:
[Cavitar]

Let me remind
you of what you

case you've forgotten.
zULA:
[Cavitar]
40 Large Jellopy,
10 Emveretarcon,
3 Coal and
10 Zargon.
Come back
whenever you're ready.
zkLA:
[Cavitar]
Recently, we've had some
tunnel cave-ins which resulted
in miner casualties. We're having
a harder time working in the
mines now that we're even
lower on manpower.
z0LA:
[Cavitar]
What's really suspicious
is that it seems something
has been making the tunnels
collapse on purpose. Some of
us believe it's because we've
angered the master of the cave.
0ELA:
[Cavitar]
The tunnel accident
is still fresh in my mind.
It seems that there are
more ^FF0000Cave Master^000000 sightings
when the tunnels started
to inexplicably collapse.
0ULA:
[Cavitar]
I was off duty when
the accident happened.
Still, I hear the only survivor
went crazy and disappeared
somewhere. The poor bastard...
0kLA:
[Cavitar]
You're...
You're just as
bad off as I am!
I feel so sorry for you
that I'd give you some
zeny if I could spare it...
00LA:
[Cavitar]
Hmm...?
I'm sorry, but
I don't think I have
the luxury of chatting
at the moment.
1ELA:
[Cavitar]
My wife was seriously
injured when she was
working with me in the
mine when it collapsed.
It's agonizing, wondering
if she'll be okay or not.
1ULA:
[Cavitar]
Luckily no one
was killed, but my
wife is... ^333333*S-Sob*^000000
I'm sorry, but I need
to be alone right now...
2ULA:
[Cavitar]
Are you serious?!
Thank you, thank you so much!
A-as you can see, I'm not doing
so well financially. But I've got to get my wife to a hospital.
2kLA:
[Cavitar]
And since I've got to
take of her myself,
I haven't been able to work.
I don't know what I should do.
3ELA:

I'm one of the few
people who's lived
in both Einbech and
Einbrock for a long time.
So I guess I'm one of the
best guides of this area.
sGrJ:
[Jung]
Say, if you're thinking of
entering the Mine Dungeon,
I can tell you all I know about
the monsters in that place so
that you'll be better prepared.
s2rJ:
[Jung]
Let's see. Ah, the monsters that are unique to the Mine Dungeon
are Noxious, Venomous, Pollcellio and Obsidian. Which one do you
want to know more about?
t2rJ:
[Jung]
You know, no one seems
to know where Noxious and
Venomous have come from.
It's like they appeared out of
nowhere when Einbroch
started to industrialize.
uGrJ:
[Jung]
Now that I think about it,
I don't think they're naturally created monsters. They have
this fixed look of despair and
suffering and tend to act like they want their enemies to kill them.
uWrJ:
[Jung]
Still, you'd better be careful!
careful! Noxious and Venomous
are stealthy monsters that can
glide quietly through the air
and attack you before
you even notice...
umrJ:
[Jung]
You should know that
Noxious is Ghost property
and Venomous is Poison.
Both are medium sized,
formless monsters.
u2rJ:
[Jung]
Both of them drop Apple,
Dust Pollutant, Toxic Gas,
Poisonous Powder, Bacillus,
Mold Powder and Anodyne.
vGrJ:
[Jung]
That's all for now.
Feel free to ask me
if you have any questions
about monsters in the Mine
Dungeon. Be safe, adventurer.
vWrJ:
[Jung]
Pollcellio is an insect that
lives in caves and drinks water
dripped from stalactites. It's
different from Ungoliant since
it likes to be near different
kinds of minerals and ores.
vmrJ:
[Jung]
Pollcellio drops Jubilee,
Insect Antenna, Single Cell,
Moss of Morning Dew, Neon
Liquid and a few other things
I can't quite remember.
v2rJ:
[Jung]
Lastly, Pollcellio is an
Earth property monster.
That's all I know about it.
But if you want to know more
about some other monster in the
Mine Dungeon, feel free to ask.
wGrJ:
[Jung]
Do you know about the
belief that underground
minerals that contain huge
amounts of energy actually
have souls? Obsidian is
one of these living rocks.
wWrJ:
[Jung]
Supposedly, just a piece of an Obsidian in a Jung Processor has enough energy to light up the night sky. Unfortunately, it's impossible to capture one alive and hunting them isn't so easy.
wmrJ:
[Jung]
Obsidian is a small,
shapeless monster that
drops Clear Jewel, Piece of
Black Crystal, Coal, Elunium,
Iron and Steel.
w2rJ:
[Jung]
That's all for Obsidian.
If you have any questions
about other monsters living
in the Mine Dungeon, feel
free to ask me.
xGrJ:
[Jung]
I understand if you're
kind of in a hurry. Still,
if you're pretty new around
here, you should learn as
much as you can before
entering any dungeons.
xWrJ:
[Jung]
Alright then,
be safe on your
adventures, alright?
x2rJ:
[Franz]
So bored...
Starving for...
Conversation.
S-somebody...
yGrJ:
[Franz]
Hey, a traveller!
Are you planning to explore
the Mine Dungeon or the fields
around here? Let's chat for a bit and maybe you'll learn something.
ymrJ:
[Franz]
Ooh, have you heard
about the creature in the
Mine Dungeon or what's
happened in town recently?
Which would you like to
know more about?
zWrJ:
[Franz]
The creature I'm talking about is Ungoliant, which also called the Master of the Caves around here.
It's said to live deep in the caves where it guards peculiar ores and minerals with strange powers.
zmrJ:
[Franz]
At first I thought it was
just an old fairy tale, but it
actually started appearing
again about ten years ago
when the tunnel cave-ins
started to happen.
z2rJ:
[Franz]
As sightings of Ungoliant
increased, more and more
tunnel cave-ins occurred.
I guess the miners have
inadvertently intruded
into its territory.
0GrJ:
[Franz]
According to legend,
ancient giants snuck into
a mine to steal coal from
humans. But they made too
much noise while they were
digging and awoke Ungoliant.
0WrJ:
[Franz]
When the miners went to work
the next morning, they found the bloodied bodies of those giants.
After that, people have feared
the threat that Ungoliant poses
to anyone entering the mines.
0mrJ:
[Franz]
Now, an adventurer that
managed to kill an Ungoliant
has told me that it drops Ant's
Jaw, Colorful Shell, Very Hard
Shell, Long Leg, Neon Liquid
and Zilcon.
02rJ:
[Franz]
In Einbroch, there was
a short lived teddy bear
fad. However, a series of
mysterious accidents and
murders where entire familes
were killed also occurred.
1GrJ:
[Franz]
It turns out that every family
that had been murdered had
bought one of these teddy bears. There were even rumors that these teddy bears were coming to life.
1WrJ:
[Franz]
After an investigation, the
authorities learned that all the merchants who sold these bears
had purchased them from the
same wholesaler, an outsider
no one knew anything about.
1mrJ:
[Franz]
Since the teddy bears were
clearly not made to be mere,
harmless toys, troops were
sent to secure all the teddy
bears and dispose of them
outside of town.
12rJ:
[Franz]
But as soon as the teddy
bears were set outside of
town, they sprang to life and
started rioting! This is clear
proof that these bears are
controlled by some evil force.
2GrJ:
[Franz]
Now those aggressive teddy
bears are scattered all over
the place and the government
	has classified them as monsters. Kill with extreme prejudice!
2WrJ:
[Franz]
According to adventurers
who have caught these bears,
they're small, neutral monsters
which drop Honey, Screw, Well-baked Cookie and Oridecon Hammer.
2mrJ:
[Franz]
That's all I know
about it. Watch out
for those bears if you
go exploring, okay? They
may be cute, but they're
known to be extremely vicious!
22rJ:
[Franz]
Oh, okay.
You're busy and you have
things to do, I understand.
You probably have to head
off somewhere right away.
Right. Got it.
3GrJ:
[Franz]
I...
I've got stuff
I should be working
on. Yes. So very busy.

d/HK:

evHK:

doesn't affect me, why
should I be concerned?

Surprisingly, we have
a Train Station that everyone

be more amazed by the Airship?
ffHK:

Now, if you want to know

still, I guess having our own
Train Station is a good thing.

globe. My bosses have
a keen eye for the most

gPHK:

Jellopy, though that stuff is

[Ohno Tohiro]
I was asked to collect some kind of research charts...

[Ohno Tohiro]

[Ohno Tohiro]
Oh somebody has come! I'll call you again later.
qXXp:
[Ohno Tohiro]
My shoulders are heavy.
Our long-cherished wish...
One by one, slowly...

[Ohno Tohiro]
Uh...? I didn't realize someone is here already...
hmm... hmm...
Is there something you want from me?
rHXp: Ask him about the Tomb of Honor.
rXXp: Return to the Tomb of Honor.
r3Xp:
[Ohno Tohiro]
There are many adventurers looking for this crevice, except for you!

sXXp:
[Ohno Tohiro]
You also heard about the crevice that leads to that place, right?
snXp: There are many adventurers like you these days!
s3Xp:
[Ohno Tohiro]
I entered this crevice for the first time and guess what? It led to the place where there are so many monsters swarming around.
tHXp:
[Ohno Tohiro]
I gave a heads up to one adventurer I know. Then, he showed a high interest in it!
tXXp: He kept muttering to himself about biomedical research, labs... something like that.
tnXp:
[Ohno Tohiro]
He kept asking me to show him how to get there. I felt reluctant to let him know about this crevice because I didn't want others to know about it. But I traded this info for 100,000 Zeny.
t3Xp:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Not much later, he came back with his body thoroughly injured. It was a miracle that he came back alive... It was horrible...
uHXp: However, he was holding several items. At first glance, they looked so powerful that even I felt scared.
uXXp:
[Ohno Tohiro]
After that, many adventurers entered this dangerous place through this crevice after hearing the rumor. I hardly found any adventurers coming out of this crevice again. Since then, this place has been called the Tomb of Honor.
unXp: I earned some money thanks to them, though.
u3Xp:
[Ohno Tohiro]
You want to know why I earned money?
I found this place for the first time, so its ownership belongs to me as well! You got a problem with that?
vHXp:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Hmm hmm... Anyway, give me 100,000 Zeny. Then, I'll open the door which leads to the crevice for adventurers like you...
vXXp:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Oh, But it seems
you don't have enough experience!
If you go in
right now, you might die.
vnXp:
[Ohno Tohiro]
I don't want to feel
bad after sending you there so
come back when you are stronger.
v3Xp:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Let me see... one... two... three
Alright. Now that I received the Zeny, I'll open the crevice.
wHXp: I hope you can come back alive!...
wXXp:
[Ohno Tohiro]
You don't have enough money!
There is nothing free in this world!
wnXp:
[Ohno Tohiro]
What? You don't have enough Zeny, but you want to enter?
Hmm... Then... by any chance, you have a research chart?
w3Xp:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Hush, speak quietly. People around here may hear us. Do you have it or not?
xHXp:
[Ohno Tohiro]

especially pleasant today?

[Errende]

[Errende]

[Errende]

[Errende]
I'd be lying if I didn't say that the sisters that work the Pub and Inn are... ^FF6699sensuously captivating^000000.
axGqAg:
[Errende]
The elder one is gorgeous, graceful and carries with her an air of refinement. And the younger one is so cheerful, energetic and so... ^FF6699nubile^000000.
bBGqAg:
[Errende]
But I digress.
Sometimes though,
just sometimes mind you,
they're not as sexy as usual.
bRGqAg:
[Errende]
It seems the spirit of their late father, God bless his soul for siring such hot women, possesses them from time to time.

[Errende]
I guess when someone acts even

Look out for this really shady Merchant that hangs out behind

[Errende]

[Errende]
I must warn you, don't let him talk you into buying that Hood of his since he's selling it for an outrageous price. He's definitely not trustworthy.
dBGqAg:
[Errende]
Lastly, I want to mention the lost city of Geffenia, hidden under the Geffen Tower. I hear some kind of condition is required to enter Geffenia, but I'm not sure.
dRGqAg:
[Errende]
Geffenia is related to the two attractive ladies I mentioned earlier. It seems their father, William, entered Geffen Tower with a party to exterminate monsters, but he never returned.
dhGqAg:
[Errende]
It's tragic that he left his family behind in that way. But perhaps, it is more tragic that his spirit scares away anyone interested in those girls.
dxGqAg:
[Errende]
Okay, let me tell you a story about Morroc, city of the desert. Adventurers worth their salt are expected to have explored the city and its surrounding desert.
eBGqAg:
[Errende]
The Sphinx and the Pyramids are especially popular areas of exploration for adventurers. Have you been there before? I haven't yet, but perhaps someday I'll go.
eRGqAg:
[Errende]
While I was in Morroc, I found a Merchant that sells Sword Maces to Priests and Priestess. Aside from those, Priests are prohibited from using any kind of weapon with blades.
ehGqAg:
[Errende]
I also saw an energetic little boy who kept begging his father to tame a Munak for him. I heard the father speak a bit, and it seems that one of his friends from Morroc is lost in Alberta.
exGqAg:
[Errende]
In any case, I helped the father with an errand, and he gave me a mysterious box in return. When I opened that box, I found a strange feather. I'm unaware of how it works, though...
fBGqAg:
[Errende]
I wonder if that man's friend, Pandger Mayer, ever found
his way back home...
fRGqAg:
[Errende]

fhGqAg:
[Errende]
When the sunken ship first drifted near Alberta, it was immediately found by one of the Alberta Security Knights.
fxGqAg:
[Errende]
That Security Knight ventured inside and found an infant deep inside one of the rooms. Next to the baby was a music box.
gBGqAg:
[Errende]
This baby was the one and only survivor from the sunken ship. He was brought up in Alberta, although he was treated with contempt when he was a child. He's fine now, but I digress.
gRGqAg:
[Errende]
As for the sunken ship, I'm unsure of whether or not it was a pirate ship. It is said that skeleton monsters wearing pirate costumes roam its remains.
ghGqAg:
[Errende]

[Errende]

[Errende]

hRGqAg:
[Errende]

[Errende]
Oh, how disappointing. But promise me that you will drop by later, so that we can share stories and merriment.

Ah... Hah hah hah. Lenore, cut them some slack, will you? Hey, adventurer. You shouldn't touch things without asking first.
3vPdAg: The Rune Knights are a group of advanced Swordsmen that practice both swordsmanship and magic, following Beelzeb, the legendary swordmaster and creator of the Dragon Sword style.
3/PdAg: They're distinguished from other Swordsmen for their use of the runes that enable them to employee magic without the innate magic power with which they were not born with.
4PPdAg: This revolutionary method of magic application is still being studied, but it's already debunked the consensus that one has to be born with the ability to generate mana to be able to use magic.
4fPdAg: Its pioneer, Swordmaster Beelzeb, sought ways to free himself from the physical limits of the human realm when he'd reached his limits, and started interacting with some magical beings in the Otherworld at least a decade ago.
4vPdAg: They were the Laphine, the elementals of the Otherworld whose existence was revealed after the borders between dimensions collapsed because of Satan Morroc's resurrection. It's believed they're deeply related to the birth of the Rune Knights.
4/PdAg: The Otherworldly creatures generate and store mana differently from humans. The Laphine Beelzeb with his study into a medium that could store their mana and enable non-magic users to use it.
5PPdAg: The results were the rune magic and runestones. With them, Beelzeb successfully combined the sword and magic and create a whole new branch of the Swordsman, now known as the Rune Knight.
5fPdAg: The runes are gemstones that can store and release the invisible force called magic.
5vPdAg: Originally developed by Serfeone, the Laphine sage, and Beelzeb, the founder of the Rune Knights, the runes are now also being studied in the human realm as an alternative source of energy with endless potential.
5/PdAg: All creatures of Ash Vacuum, also known as the Otherworld, are born with a source of mana in them, regardless of their size, and the runes are an energy storage device based on their mana.
6PPdAg: Mana can be extracted from the Otherworldly creatures, and then condensed into these rules through Rune Mastery, the advanced rune-refining technology created by Beelzeb and only shared among his students, the Rune Knights.
6fPdAg: Principles of Runes and Their Kinds
7PPdAg: The runes are a logographic system with shamanic meanings.  They've long been used in certain parts of the Midgard Continent before the Rune-Midgard Kingdom's establishment.
7fPdAg: So far, no historical document on the rune systems and their meanings has been discovered, but that hasn't stopped scholars in Geffen, Juno, and Arunafeltz from studying them.
7vPdAg: The runes are a logography also popularly used to tell the future and for ritualistic purposes, such as tapping into people's minds.
7/PdAg: Each rune has its own system and branches and can achieve different effects, depending on the pattern. The power of the runes is immeasurable by the current science.
8PPdAg: The runes were brought to light when the Rune Knights revealed themselves. Their potential is generally perceived positively, but some people have voiced concern that they can be dangerous in the wrong hands.
8fPdAg: The rune system consists of a total of 25 small stones that are vulnerable to impact. They must be stored and handled with caution.
8vPdAg: Each of these 25 runes has a different meaning. 14 of them also takes on a completely different meaning when placed reversed, creating endless possibilities in rune combinations.
8/PdAg: The other 11 retain their meaning, no matter the position. To use the rune system to its fullest potential, one must master all the 11 proper runes and 14 reverse runes. The blank rune among the 11 proper runes is considered an exception.
9PPdAg: The 25 runestones are called as follows.
9fPdAg: Ehwaz, Osilia, Mannaz, Ansuz, Hagalas, Kano, Rhydo, Turisus, Dagaz, Sowilo, Laguz, Isia, Pertz, Verkana, Gebo, Algiz, Arwez, Teiwaz, Wunjo, Jera, Nosiege, Ingz, Fehu, and Urj.
9vPdAg: How to Make and Use Runes
+fPdAg: The Rune Knights can create runestones through one of their unique skills called Rune Mastery. This Rune Mastery is the symbol of their class, a unique code embedded in their bodies.
+vPdAg: Even if you're not a Rune Knight, you can make runes, but with limitations. You also need the special device called the rune furnace.
+/PdAg: When you use the rune furnace, the type of the rune you can create depends on the magic energy that enters the furnace, and it can't be changed.
/PPdAg: If you're a Rune Knight, you can create whatever runestone you want through Rune Mastery.
/fPdAg: To create runestones through the rune furnace, accumulate Otherworldly magic energy in your body and then activate the rune furnace. Your magic energy will enter the furnace and form a runestone.

[Salim Hamid]

[Salim Hamid]

[Salim Hamid]

[Salim Hamid]

[Butler Aidin]

[Butler Aidin]

[Butler Aidin]

[Butler Aidin]

yRgEAw:
[Butler Aidin]

[Butler Aidin]

[Butler Aidin]

zhgEAw:
[Butler Aidin]

zxgEAw:
[Butler Aidin]

you can learn this skill to identify equipment dropped from monsters anytime, anywhere.

There's a clear difference between hitting something and pushing it away. When you hit it, you bring your hand or weapon into contact with it quickly and forcefully.

[Simon]

[Simon]

[Simon]

[Simon]

4zAnAw:
[Simon]

5DAnAw:
[Simon]

[Phecda]

^FF0000Passive Skills are skills that stay active from the moment you acquire them.^000000

1wslCg:
[Divine Protection]
Divine Protection is a skill ^FF0000that raises your physical defense against the Undead or Demons^000000.

2AslCg:
[Demon Bane]
Demon Bane is a Passive Skill ^FF0000that raises your physical attack capability against the Undead and Demons^000000.
^FF0000It's not common for Support Acolytes to invest points in this skill, but it's a useful skill for Battle Acolytes or Apprentice Monks.^000000
2QslCg:
[Acolyte Leader Alice]

5gslCg:
[Heal]
Heal is ^FF0000a basic Acolyte skill that restores health^000000.
^FF0000If you press Shift while using the Heal skill, you can also deal damage to the Undead.^000000

5wslCg:
[Blessing]
Blessing is a versatile skill that ^FF0000increases STR, INT, and DEX as well as undoes Curse or Petrify effects^000000.
However, ^FF0000when used on the Undead or Demons, it inflicts a Curse on them^000000.
6AslCg:
[Increase Agility]
Increase Agility is a skill that increases your speed.
^FF0000Your speed will double and AGI will increase, so the speed of your attack will be faster and your FLEE ^000000 will go up.
6QslCg:
[Decrease Agility]
Decrease Agility is a skill that has the opposite effect of Increase Agility.
^FF0000Your speed and AGI will decrease, so your ASPD and FLEE will go down.^000000
This means the effectiveness of your skills will also decrease.
6gslCg:
[Angelus]
Angelus is a skill that ^FF0000increases defense^000000.
It's a skill that proves useful in dungeons where there are strong monsters, as it will raise not only your own defense, but also that of nearby team members.
6wslCg:
[Signum Crucis]
Signum Crucis ^FF0000is a skill that lowers the enemy's defense^000000.
It's a useful skill when a monster has strong defense, but lately the preferred tactic seems to be increasing one's own attack rather than lowering the enemy's defense.
7AslCg:
[Cure]
Cure is a skill that cures ^FF0000status effects such as Blind, Silence, and Confusion^000000.
It's used less often these days thanks to Panacea and other such items.
7QslCg:
[Aqua Benedicta]
Aqua Benedicta is a skill that allows you to make ^FF0000Holy Water^000000.
If you have an ^FF0000empty bottle^000000, you can make Holy Water at any place where you can access^FF0000water^000000.
7gslCg:
[Ruwach]
Ruwach is ^FF0000a skill that helps you find hidden enemies^000000.
It's different from the Mage skill Sight, in that you can also deal damage to enemies once you find them.
Some people like that, and some others don't.
7wslCg:
[Teleport]

Using this skill, you can ^FF0000travel to a random place on the map, or Kafra if you have it saved^000000.

8AslCg:
